info.title: MadeOnSol API
info.description:
Real-time Solana & Robinhood Chain trading intelligence — KOL wallet trades, deployer reputation, token buyer-quality scoring, wallet tracking, and copy-trade signals across both chains (Robinhood Chain paths under `/rhc/*`).

**Data freshness per tier**: live-feed endpoints (KOL feeds, deployer alerts, graduations, first-touches, coordination) are **real-time on PRO and up and on x402 pay-per-call; delayed 5 minutes on the free tier** (delayed responses carry `delay`, `as_of` and an `X-Data-Delay` header). Scores, leaderboards, wallet PnL, holder data and search are real-time on every tier.

**Authentication**: pass `Authorization: Bearer msk_xxx` on every request. See pricing + start free at https://madeonsol.com/pricing (200 calls/day free tier, no payment to start).

**Tiers**: BASIC (free, 200/day) · PRO (€43/mo ≈ $49, 10,000/day) · ULTRA (€131/mo ≈ $149, 100,000/day) · BUSINESS (€400/mo ≈ $456, 500,000/day, embed license + bulk Parquet exports) · ENTERPRISE (custom — SLA, dedicated limits, redistribution; info@madeonsol.com). Pay by card, USDC, or SOL. Full plan comparison: https://madeonsol.com/pricing

**Tier per operation**: every operation carries `x-madeonsol-tier` — the minimum plan that unlocks it, one of `FREE` `PRO` `ULTRA` `BUSINESS` `ENTERPRISE`, read from the route's own gate (a higher plan always passes). The top-level `x-madeonsol-tiers` legend lists each tier's name, price and quota. A call below the gate returns 403 with an `upgrade` block.

**Try it now**: a public demo key works on `/kol/feed`, `/deployer-hunter/alerts`, and `/alpha/leaderboard` — see https://madeonsol.com/api-docs

**Response headers**: every response carries `X-Request-Id` (quote it in support requests). Once your key is authenticated, responses also carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Used` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (Unix epoch seconds); authentication-stage errors (401, invalid-key 403) do not. Quota 429s, concurrency 429s and 503s carry `Retry-After` (seconds). Each operation documents these headers and its error bodies through the reusable `components.headers` and `components.responses`. Free-tier responses past ~70% of the daily quota also carry an `X-MadeOnSol-Quota-Warning` header with an upgrade link.

**Changelog**: see https://madeonsol.com/changelog for recent updates.

BearerAuth.description: Get a free API key at https://madeonsol.com/developer

RhcHolderGrowthWindow.description: One holder-growth window on /rhc/tokens/{address}/holders. Pools and burn addresses are excluded from every count.

cutoff_block.description: Lowest block observed at-or-after now()−window (resolved from our trade ingest, ~10 blocks/s).

entered.description: Addresses whose first Transfer of this token landed at-or-after cutoff_block (any current balance).

exited.description: Pre-existing holders whose last Transfer in the window left them at zero.

net.description: entered_still_holding − exited ≈ change in holder_count over the window.

RhcTokenRiskSummary.description:
Precomputed risk summary for a Robinhood Chain token, from the same engine as `/rhc/tokens/{address}/risk` (proxy resolution, capability scan, and a live router sell-simulation).

**`null` means NOT ASSESSED, not safe.** The sweep covers tokens with liquidity on a ~24h rotation, so a brand-new or illiquid token has no row yet.

These values are a SNAPSHOT — always read `checked_at`. Sellability can change the moment an owner flips a setting, which is why `/rhc/tokens/{address}/risk` is computed live and never served from this cache. Use this to triage a feed; use the live endpoint before acting on a single token.

sellable.description: `no` means a sell was simulated through the router and REVERTED — bought-but-cannot-sell.

upgradeable.description: Token is a proxy whose implementation can be swapped (EIP-1967 / beacon / legacy). EIP-1167 minimal proxies are NOT upgradeable — the target is baked into immutable code.

score.description: 0–100, conservative. Absence of evidence is not evidence of safety.

wallet_count.description: Number of same-slot bundle wallets (is_bundle: ≥3 buying in one slot)

bundle_kind.description: atomic_tx = ≥3 wallets share one buy tx (definitively atomic); same_slot = the ≥3-same-slot heuristic (possible coincidence); none = no cohort

held_pct_of_supply.description: HEADLINE. Cohort net held ÷ circulating supply, 0–1 (clamped). null when supply is unknown

held_ratio.description: Cohort net held ÷ buy_volume, 0–1. Churn-sensitive — secondary to held_pct_of_supply

buy_volume.description: Cumulative buy-side token volume — NOT distinct tokens; can exceed supply on round-tripping

tokens_held.description: Swap-derived net position (Σbuys−Σsells) — a proxy for on-chain balance, not a holder census

holdings_basis.description: swap_only = token transfers are not applied: a member that transferred tokens out and sold elsewhere still reads as holding.

bundle_detection.description: How cohort membership is decided today: ≥3 wallets buying the mint in one ingest batch with the same block_time second (ingest wall-clock), not the same slot. A future value `same_slot` ships with BUNDLE_SLOT_DETECTION=on.

wallets.description: BASIC: empty. PRO: top-10, flags only. ULTRA: full cohort + identity fields.

atomic.description: This wallet is part of an atomic single-tx bundle

balance_now.description: Only with include_balances=true: this wallet's current balance of the mint (null when the cohort read failed).

held_now.description: Only with include_balances=true (PRO+, 2026-10-15): the cohort's CURRENT balances, one owner read per wallet (every token account of the owner for the mint, either program). Totals only when every wallet was read; the bundle answer itself never fails on a balance read.

held_pct_of_supply.description: RATIO in [0, 1] of circulating_supply_raw, like bundle.held_pct_of_supply.

Error.description: Generic error envelope. `error` is always present (SDKs match on it). Errors returned after authentication also carry `_rid` and, on paid tiers, `support`; authentication-stage errors (missing/invalid key, origin) carry neither.

error.description: Error message or machine code (e.g. `tier_required`, `rate_limit_exceeded`). Never changed once shipped.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, when `error` is a machine code.

retry_after_seconds.description: When present on a 429/503, the same value is sent as the `Retry-After` header.

signup_url.description: On the missing-key / bad-format 401: where to get a free key.

support.description: Paid tiers, errors after authentication: priority support contact.

_rid.description: Request ID — include when reporting issues

TierRequiredError.description: 403 when the key's tier is below the endpoint's (or a parameter's) gate. `required_tier` matches the operation's `x-madeonsol-tier` or `x-madeonsol-feature-tiers`. ENTERPRISE gates return `contact` instead of `upgrade`.

upgrade.description: The plan that lifts this limit, with price and a checkout link.

reactivate.description: Present (true) when the key's paid subscription has just lapsed and `tier` is the plan it held.

DemoKeyNotAllowedError.description: 403 for the public demo key (`msk_demo_…`) outside its three-endpoint allow-list. `endpoint_tier` is the endpoint's real minimum plan (null when unknown).

upgrade_url.description: Only when the endpoint's tier can be bought at /checkout.

RateLimitError.description: 429 when a quota is exhausted: the daily quota, the per-minute burst, or a free-tier network/key-rotation cap. `datasets` is added on `daily` only.

upgrade.description: The plan that lifts this limit, with price and a checkout link.

reactivate.description: Present (true) when the key's paid subscription has just lapsed and `tier` is the plan it held.

ConcurrencyLimitError.description: 429 from the heavy-query limiter: too many heavy requests in flight for this key (`concurrency`) or for the whole server (`capacity`). Clears as soon as in-flight requests finish.

ServiceUnavailableError.description: 503: a temporary capacity or maintenance condition (e.g. a Postgres statement timeout during a partition move, or the API-key lookup itself being unavailable). Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

code.description: Machine-readable code where one exists, e.g. `auth_backend_unavailable`.

RhcCopytradeTrackedWallets.description: DEPRECATED 2026-10-04 (kept, still filled): subset of source_wallets in the tracked KOL set (kol_evm_wallets, the set behind /rhc/kol/wallets). KOL enrichment only once source_admission is any_wallet; under the legacy kol_only engine only these can produce a signal. null when the reference read failed.

RhcCopytradeUntrackedWallets.description: DEPRECATED 2026-10-04 (kept, still filled): subset of source_wallets NOT in the tracked KOL set. Under source_admission any_wallet they fire like any other wallet; under the legacy kol_only engine they never produce a signal. null when the reference read failed.

RhcCopytradeOperationalState.description: Whether the rule can fire at all, separate from is_active (the customer switch). Under source_admission any_wallet (2026-10-04) every valid source wallet is followed, KOL or not: eligible; monitoring_pending = the rule changed after the engine's last rule load (live within seconds); monitoring_unavailable = the engine or the trade stream is not reporting, and it fires nothing until it is (see monitoring_reasons); source_capacity_unavailable = the engine's source-wallet cap is reached. Legacy (source_admission kol_only or absent): no_tracked_sources = none of source_wallets is a tracked KOL wallet (kol_evm_wallets on Robinhood Chain, active kol_wallets on Solana), so the rule cannot fire; unknown = the tracking read failed.

RhcCopytradeSourceAdmission.description: Which trades the RUNNING copy-trade engine admits (shared by the Solana and Robinhood Chain rules). any_wallet: a qualifying trade by any source wallet, KOL or not (Robinhood Chain: the ERC-4337 userOp sender on bundled transactions; Solana: the same effective-trader rule as KOL attribution). kol_only: only tracked KOL wallets (kol_evm_wallets / active kol_wallets), legacy. Absent when the engine state could not be read (legacy semantics). Added 2026-10-04.

RhcCopytradeMonitoringReasons.description: Present only with operational_state monitoring_unavailable: the infrastructure reasons (e.g. dex_stream_stale, trade_stream_stale, source_producer_stale, map_stale, bus_disconnected, engine_state_stale). Added 2026-10-04.

RhcCopytradeRuleWarnings.description: Present only when something needs attention (the key is omitted otherwise, never null). Additive — status codes and existing fields never change. Emitted only under source_admission kol_only (legacy); under any_wallet an untracked wallet is not a problem and no warning is attached.

CopytradeSubscription.description: A copy-trade rule: source wallets to mirror, sizing, delivery, and optional MC bounds.

source_wallets.description: Wallets being copied. Any valid Solana wallet once source_admission is any_wallet; under the legacy kol_only engine only active tracked KOL wallets fire — see source_admission and operational_state.

min_trade_sol.description: Skip source trades below this SOL size

sizing_amount.description: fixed = SOL amount, proportional = multiplier (0.5 = half size), percent_source = 0..1

source_wallets_tracked.description: DEPRECATED 2026-10-04 (kept, still filled): subset of source_wallets that are active tracked Solana KOL wallets (the set behind /kol/wallets). KOL enrichment only once source_admission is any_wallet; under the legacy kol_only engine only these produce signals. null when the lookup failed. Added 2026-09-25.

source_wallets_untracked.description: DEPRECATED 2026-10-04 (kept, still filled): subset of source_wallets that are not tracked KOL wallets. Under source_admission any_wallet they fire like any other wallet (no Wallet Tracker entry needed, no Wallet Tracker quota used); under the legacy kol_only engine they never produce a signal. null when the lookup failed. Added 2026-09-25.

WebhookFilters.description: Optional per-event delivery filters on a webhook. wallet_tracker:event (since 2026-09-25): only min_sol, action and conditions on its own fields apply, after the subscriber check; on a webhook subscribed to wallet_tracker:event alone any other named filter is a 400.

action.description: kol:trade, wallet_tracker:event (transfers have no action and are excluded)

types.description: dev:activity and rhc:dev_activity: event types to deliver. rhc:dev_activity carries dev_buy / dev_sell only (developer token transfers are never delivered on Robinhood Chain in v1), so the transfer types never match there.

deployers.description: dev:activity (base58) and rhc:dev_activity (0x, case-insensitive): matches deployer_wallet or actor_wallet

conditions.description: ULTRA+ (2026-09-08). Custom { field, op, value } triples ANDed together and evaluated against the raw event payload, on top of the named filters. `field` must be a documented payload field of one of the webhook's subscribed event types (one level of dot-path allowed, e.g. `triggering_trade.sol_amount`); anything else is a 400. Number fields take eq/neq/gt/gte/lt/lte/in, strings eq/neq/in/contains, booleans eq/neq. On PRO the request is a 403 tier_required.

value.description: number | string | boolean, or a non-empty array (≤20) for `in`.

events.description: dev:activity (live since 2026-10-05): developer dev_sell / dev_buy / dev_token_transfer_out / dev_token_transfer_in, projected per tier at delivery (PRO: the developer's own events, raw facts, no identity keys; ULTRA+: identity fields and linked-wallet events from proven links only). Dedupe on data.id. Solana transfers combine the legacy bounded wallet watch with the broad SPL Token / Token-2022 candidate source for attributed creators; transfer_watch_coverage describes the legacy watch only, while broad-source state/gaps are reported separately. Recovered broad-source rows can appear in REST history but are not retroactively re-sent as WS/webhook alerts. rhc:dev_activity: Robinhood Chain developer dev_buy / dev_sell ONLY (the token's recorded deployer trading it; developer token transfers are never delivered), PRO+, same projection and dedupe; payload fields as dev:activity with chain=robinhood, signature=tx hash, slot=block number. Live since 2026-10-05.

InsiderFlowCohort.description: One cohort (or the deduplicated `insiders` union) inside one window. Every amount is null when the window is `not_captured`.

buy_sol.description: Proven SOL spent on buys (unpriced trades excluded and counted in unpriced_trades).

net_sell_sol.description: sell_sol - buy_sol. Null when amounts are partial or the window overlaps a capture gap.

net_sell_pct_of_buy_volume.description: PERCENT: net_sell_sol / every proven buy in the window x 100.

status.description: gap_unverified = a recorded capture gap has no usable time bound, so the window cannot be shown gap-free: nets and ratios are null (gap_state_unverified).

market.description: Every stored trade of the token in the window.

TradeCoverage.description: Coverage disclosure for endpoints backed by our persisted trade capture (`token_trades` / early-buyer data). Capture starts 2026-04-12 and persistence is gated to the launchpad pipeline (pump.fun, LaunchLab/bonk, bags) — it is NOT a full Solana trade history. Three separate answers (2026-09-21): `data_observed`/`in_scope` = at least one persisted row (presence, not completeness — a brand-new in-scope mint with no trades yet also reads false), `eligibility` = whether the CURRENT gate admits the subject, `completeness` = always `not_verified`. When no rows exist, zero/empty values mean 'not captured' (see eligibility for why), never 'no activity'.

history_start.description: Epoch seconds of the first persisted trade (2026-04-12).

in_scope.description: Kept for compatibility — same value as data_observed: true = we hold ≥1 persisted trade for this subject · false = none persisted (see eligibility for why — a brand-new in-scope mint also reads false) · null = probe unavailable

eligibility.description: Resolved against the EFFECTIVE production capture settings (refreshed every few minutes; if they cannot be confirmed the answer narrows, never widens). eligible = admitted by the current gate · lapsed = launched via our pipeline, capture window closed under the current settings · excluded = blacklisted · unknown = no evidence the gate admits it (most likely outside the launchpad pipeline; basis capture_state_unavailable = settings could not be confirmed, no claim either way) · admitted_previously = persisted rows prove past admission, current status not established · not_applicable = wallet subjects · null = lookup failed

eligibility_basis.description: Evidence behind eligibility (e.g. unresolved_launch, recently_bonded, revived_curve, pipeline_known, launchlab_pool, bags_vanity_mint, launchpad_proven, resolved_launch, bonded_over_7d, revival_expired, blacklisted, persisted_rows, capture_state_unavailable, lookup_failed)

size_floor.description: Persistence size floor of the same write path. It applies only to trades stored before 2026-10-22T19:53:00.000Z (captured under the legacy policy): Buys under 0.05 SOL (under $3.50 when paid in USDC/USDT) are not stored; sells that receive SOL are kept at any size. No size floor applies to trades stored from 2026-10-22T19:53:00.000Z. Live streams, prices and candles were never subject to it.

applies_to.example: buys and SOL-spending legs; SOL-receiving sells of any size are kept

removed_at.description: Trades stored from this instant are kept at any size. Absent while the floor still applies to all stored trades.

note.description: How to read the values (always present since 2026-09-21: eligibility-specific when no rows exist, a completeness caveat when they do).

event_identity.description: From events_from, a trade is stored as one row per swap instruction (event.event_id set) only when every swap leg of that wallet was proven exactly. Every other trade, and every trade stored before events_from, is one netted row per transaction and wallet (event.event_id null) holding the wallet's net amounts. Amount and volume sums are the same either way; row counts are not transaction counts. Event coverage is partial, never complete.

status.description: Never complete: unproven trades keep one netted row per transaction and wallet.

events_from.description: Per-swap-instruction rows can exist only from this instant.

fallback.description: How a trade whose swap legs were not proven exactly is stored: one netted row per (transaction, wallet), event.event_id null.

LaunchCoverage.description: Dataset-scope disclosure injected on every 200 from the launch-pipeline feeds (`/deployer-hunter/*`, `/sniper/*`, `/alpha/*`, `/tokens/almost-bonded`, `/tokens/batch/risk`, `/wallet/batch/classify`) unless the route already carries a more precise per-subject `coverage`. Static: these datasets are built from launchpad ingest (in practice ~99% pump.fun), so an absent wallet/token, an empty profile or a `false` reputation flag means 'not observed by this pipeline', never 'clean' or 'no activity'.

scope.example: launchpad pipeline (pump.fun and LaunchLab/bonk deploys; bags.fm tokens are covered in trade data but their deploys are not attributed here; no direct-to-DEX launches)

note.description: How to read absences and zeros in this response.

sol_amount.description: SOL size of the trade. null on a sell whose SOL proceeds are unknown (they went to another wallet or cannot be proven; since 2026-10-18): the sell still happened and reduced the KOL's tokens. Never read null as 0.

market_cap_usd_at_trade.description: Token market cap in USD at the moment of trade (real-time, from our in-memory price tracker — not the post-hoc Dexscreener spot)

price_usd_at_trade.description: Token price in USD at the moment of trade

launchpad.description: Launchpad of origin (`pumpfun` / `launchlab` / `bags`); null for non-launchpad mints.

token_age_minutes.description: Minutes between the token's first observed trade and now (not at trade time); null when the mint has no first-seen record.

kol_strategy_tag.description: Manual strategy tag from the roster, falling back to the auto-classified tag.

kol_auto_strategy_tag.description: Auto-classified trader style — the value `strategy=` filters on.

kol_early_entry_pct_30d.description: Share of the KOL's 30-day buys that were early entries.

kol_is_heating_up.description: KOL's recent performance is trending up vs their own baseline.

kol_percentile_pnl_7d.description: KOL's 7-day PnL percentile across the roster (0-100).

kol_percentile_winrate_7d.description: KOL's 7-day win-rate percentile across the roster (0-100).

deployer.description: Present only when the token has a tracked deployer.

deployer_tier.description: Shortcut for `deployer.tier`; present only when `deployer` is.

token.description: Present only with `include=token` — the `/token/{mint}` snapshot for this row (null past the 20-distinct-mint cap).

win_rate.description: 0-100. Over positions with known proceeds only (migration 512). Under migration 526 (win_rate_method present): the full-history FIFO win rate for 7d / 30d, null for other periods or below the minimum sample.

win_rate_method.description: Migration 526: win_rate is the full-history FIFO win rate (same number as /kol/{wallet} scores.winrate_7d / winrate_30d). Absent = the in-window leaderboard win rate.

win_rate_status.description: not_computed_for_period = the FIFO win rate exists for 7d and 30d only; today / 90d / 180d serve win_rate null.

unknown_realizations_winrate.description: Closed positions with an unproven realization in win_rate_window: not in the denominator.

strategy_tag_source.description: Where strategy_tag comes from: classifier_076 = the roster classifier (kol_wallets.strategy_tag); otherwise the auto tag and its method.

auto_strategy_tag_source.description: fifo_auto_v2 = median hold of known FIFO lots (migration 526); in_window_auto_512 = first buy to first sell per token in 30 days.

completeness.description: Realized-PnL completeness for the KOL (migration 512). incomplete when at least one KOL sell in the window has unknown SOL proceeds (they went to another wallet or cannot be proven; kol_trades valuation_status unvalued, sol_amount null): those positions still reduce holdings but are left out of realized PnL, win rate, ROI and the ranking, never booked as 0 proceeds or a loss. This is realized-PnL completeness. It is NOT `coverage.completeness` (source-coverage verification: verified / not_verified / ...), which says whether the trade capture for this subject is proven complete.

incomplete_reasons.description: Empty when complete; proceeds_unattributed when unknown_realizations > 0.

unknown_realizations.description: Migration 512: (KOL, token) positions with a sell whose proceeds are unknown, excluded from realized PnL / win rate / ROI. 0 when complete.

unknown_proceeds_sells.description: Migration 512: KOL sells with unknown proceeds (sol_amount null) in the window. 0 when complete.

median_hold_minutes_30d.description: Median hold time in minutes over the last 30 days.

percentile_early_entry_30d.description: Percentile rank for early entry timing over the last 30 days.

avg_winrate_7d.description: Mean 7d winrate across the cluster's KOLs

entry_rank_avg.description: Avg early-entry percentile (lower = earlier in the trade)

unique_strategies.description: Count of distinct auto_strategy_tag values across the KOLs

time_to_consensus_sec.description: Seconds between first and last KOL buy (full-period span)

peak_window_start.description: Start of densest buy cluster (default 15-min window)

peak_kols.description: Distinct KOLs buying inside the peak window

peak_buys.description: Total buys inside the peak window

exited_count.description: KOLs in the cluster whose sell_sol > buy_sol (net-flow-negative)

coordination_score.description: Composite 0-100 signal score. Weighting exposed via top-level score_version.

market_cap_usd_at_first_buy.description: Market cap (USD) stamped on the cluster's chronologically-first KOL buy. Distinguishes coordinated accumulation at micro-cap from late-stage chasing.

market_cap_usd.description: Current market cap (USD) of the token, sourced from token_prices. Compare against market_cap_usd_at_first_buy for the cluster's MC delta.

mc_change_pct.description: Market-cap % change over each window (e.g. 12.4 = +12.4%). Sparse — only windows with enough mc-tracker history are present. Use to tell whether the cluster is firing into a moving token or before the move.

volume_usd.description: Organic (non-MEV) USD volume over each window. Sparse — same gating as mc_change_pct.

mev_volume_pct.description: MEV-share of total volume over each window (0-100). High value = bot-heavy / sandwich-heavy flow.

history_age_seconds.description: Seconds of mc-tracker history available for this token (capped at 4h05m). Tells you which windows can be trusted. Null when token is untracked.

kols.description: BASIC: array of KOL names (first 3). PRO+: objects {name, wallet, buy_sol, sell_sol, exited} — full wallet addresses on every tier that can call the endpoint (BASIC gets 403 on /kol/coordination).

CoordinationAlertRule.description: A saved /kol/coordination/alerts rule. `created_at` is present on list/GET-one responses; `updated_at` is present on GET-one/PATCH responses (list omits it).

FirstTouchSubscription.description: A saved /kol/first-touches/subscriptions subscription. `created_at` is present on list/GET-one/PATCH responses; `updated_at` is present on GET-one/PATCH responses (list omits it).

confidence.description: Confidence in the PREDICTIVE inputs: counts only buyers whose win rate fed the score (≥3 tokens of history, not bot-flagged, not zero-cost-dump dominated). insufficient_data = none did — the score is the neutral-50 default plus penalties. 1 → low, 5+ → medium, 11+ → high.

avg_historical_win_rate.description: null when no buyer's win rate qualified (confidence insufficient_data)

wallets_with_history.description: Buyers with ≥3 tokens of history (cohort identification — not predictive)

qualified_win_rate_wallets.description: Buyers whose win rate fed the score — the basis of confidence

dump_cluster_count.description: First-20 buyers on the rolling dump-cluster list (wallets whose 5+ recent first-20 appearances are exclusively on tokens that peaked <15 min after deploy; trailing 42d, refreshed daily). Out-of-sample: 3+ such wallets predicted a sub-15-min peak 94% of the time vs 61% base. Informational — does not move the score.

recycled_early_buyer_count.description: First-20 buyers with 5+ recent first-20 cohort appearances of any kind. The count alone predicts nothing; a heavily recycled cohort with dump_cluster_count 0 historically leans runner.

note.description: Present only when no early-buyer data exists for the mint — the score is then a neutral 50 placeholder ("Insufficient buyer data"); check coverage to tell 'no early buyers captured' from 'mint outside the write-gate'.

signal_stats.description: Present only when breakdown.dump_cluster_count ≥ 1 and the daily signal-performance snapshot has a bucket for it. The live, out-of-sample efficacy of that value, so the raw count is readable.

bucket.description: Most specific cumulative-threshold bucket the value qualifies for.

outcome.description: Outcome the hit rate is measured against.

as_of.description: Snapshot time of the signal_performance row.

summary.example: dump_cluster_count=3 (k>=3): 95% of such tokens dumped vs 75% base (1.27× lift), n=349, 14d OOS

dump_cluster_held_now.description: Only with include_balances=true (PRO+, 2026-10-15, TR-09): the early buyers counted in dump_cluster_count and what they hold NOW from balances. Totals only when every member was read.

members.description: Dump-cluster members among the early buyers (= dump_cluster_count).

held_now.description: Same shape as the bundle held_now of this chain: source, checked_at, wallets, verified_wallets, holding_wallets, complete, incomplete_reason, tokens_held_raw, tokens_held, held_pct_of_supply (ratio), supply_basis.

BuyerQualityBatchItem.description: Per-mint item of POST /tokens/batch/buyer-quality: the GET /tokens/{mint}/buyer-quality shape WITHOUT `signal_stats` (the batch path does not attach the signal-performance snapshot).

confidence.description: Confidence in the PREDICTIVE inputs: counts only buyers whose win rate fed the score (≥3 tokens of history, not bot-flagged, not zero-cost-dump dominated). insufficient_data = none did — the score is the neutral-50 default plus penalties. 1 → low, 5+ → medium, 11+ → high.

avg_historical_win_rate.description: null when no buyer's win rate qualified (confidence insufficient_data)

wallets_with_history.description: Buyers with ≥3 tokens of history (cohort identification — not predictive)

qualified_win_rate_wallets.description: Buyers whose win rate fed the score — the basis of confidence

dump_cluster_count.description: First-20 buyers on the rolling dump-cluster list (wallets whose 5+ recent first-20 appearances are exclusively on tokens that peaked <15 min after deploy; trailing 42d, refreshed daily). Out-of-sample: 3+ such wallets predicted a sub-15-min peak 94% of the time vs 61% base. Informational — does not move the score.

recycled_early_buyer_count.description: First-20 buyers with 5+ recent first-20 cohort appearances of any kind. The count alone predicts nothing; a heavily recycled cohort with dump_cluster_count 0 historically leans runner.

note.description: Present only when no early-buyer data exists for the mint — the score is then a neutral 50 placeholder ("Insufficient buyer data"); check coverage to tell 'no early buyers captured' from 'mint outside the write-gate'.

WalletTrackerSummary.description: Per-wallet activity for your Solana tracked wallets over `period` (newest-added first). An empty tracker returns `{ wallets: [], period }` without `interval`.

interval.description: Postgres interval for the period, e.g. "7 days".

completeness.description: Realized-PnL completeness. incomplete when at least one sell in the response has proceeds that went to another wallet (price_status proceeds_unattributed, migration 508): realized PnL and ROI then cover the known basis only, and the basis those sells consumed is reported as unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol, never as 0 proceeds or a loss. This is realized-PnL completeness. It is NOT `coverage.completeness` (source-coverage verification: verified / not_verified / ...), which says whether the trade capture for this subject is proven complete.

incomplete_reasons.description: Empty when complete. /wallet/{address} emits only proceeds_unattributed; /tokens/{mint}/top-traders emits proceeds_unattributed and, since migration 548 (2026-11-11), unknown_consideration; unknown_consideration and missing_cost_basis (sales without an observed purchase) are shared with the FIFO routes (/pnl, /positions).

pnl_basis_note.description: Fixed sentence: realized_pnl_sol and ROI cover the known basis only; unattributed sells are excluded and the basis they consumed is unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol.

unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol.description: Migration 508: cost basis consumed by sells whose proceeds went to another wallet. NOT in realized_pnl_sol or ROI (neither a loss nor a gain). 0 when complete.

unattributed_sells.description: Migration 508: sells with price_status proceeds_unattributed. 0 when complete.

coverage_note.description: Fixed disclosure: is_sniper/is_bundler/is_dumper derive from the launchpad trade pipeline — false means 'not observed in covered trades', not 'verified clean'.

is_sniper.description: >=5 tokens early-bought & >=80% flipped <5min (behavior-updated hourly). Pump.fun-pipeline scoped; false = not observed, not verified clean

is_bundler.description: Bought >1 token in the same block, ever (lifetime flag)

is_dumper.description: >=5 dump cohorts + 0 runner cohorts in rolling 42d window (recomputed daily)

dump_cluster.description: Raw dump-cluster cohort counts (present when the wallet has >=5 recent early-buyer cohort appearances)

top_tokens.description: Top traded tokens (90d window) with realized PnL. Cross-joined with deployer-tokens for symbol + peak MC where available.

realized_pnl_sol.description: Known basis only (migration 508): sells whose proceeds went to another wallet are excluded, see unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol.

unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol.description: Migration 508: cost basis consumed by sells whose proceeds went to another wallet. NOT in realized_pnl_sol or ROI (neither a loss nor a gain). 0 when complete.

unattributed_sells.description: Migration 508: sells with price_status proceeds_unattributed. 0 when complete.

realized_status.description: known = no unattributed sell; partial = some sells unattributed (realized on the known basis); unknown = every sell unattributed: the outcome is unknown, not a loss (same vocabulary as /pnl closed_positions).

trading_style.description: Behavioural signals: avg trade size, sniper rate, round-trip rate, median hold time.

round_trip_rate.description: 0–1: fraction of tokens with both buys and sells.

median_hold_minutes.description: Median minutes between first buy and first sell across tokens.

deployer_breakdown.description: Tier distribution of pump.fun deployers this wallet has bought from. Useful for spotting alpha-buyers vs random degens.

tier.description: elite / good / rising / moderate / cold / unranked

recent_trades.description: Last 10 trades regardless of window (raw timeline, cross-joined with deployer-tokens for symbol).

derived.description: Derived wallet stats computed from the enrichments above (src/lib/wallet-enrichments.ts DerivedStats: standout trades, biggest miss, realized/unrealized PnL rollups).

stats_unavailable.description: Present (true) only when the 90-day trade aggregation failed. `stats` null is then UNPROVEN, not an inactive wallet.

enrichment_unavailable.description: Present (true) only when one or more enrichment queries failed; `degraded_fields` names them. Absent on a fully measured response.

degraded_fields.description: Enrichment blocks whose query failed (e.g. a database timeout under load). Their null / [] value is UNKNOWN, not 'no data'; retry later. `biggest_miss` refers to `derived.biggest_miss`. Present only together with `enrichment_unavailable: true`.

WalletHolding.description: One chain-verified token holding. `transfer_delta` = on-chain amount minus trade-derived net (non-null only when the mint was traded in-window); a large positive delta flags tokens received without a swap.

amount_raw.description: Raw integer amount (pre-decimals) as a string.

completeness.description: incomplete when at least one disposal's realized PnL is unknown (a sell whose proceeds provably went to another wallet, price_status proceeds_unattributed; or a trade with unknown consideration). Such a disposal consumes the FIFO lots (holdings are right) but is excluded from realized_sol, wins/losses, win_rate, profit_factor and best/worst — never booked as 0 proceeds. Absent on analyses cached before this field existed. This is realized-PnL completeness. It is NOT `coverage.completeness` (source-coverage verification: verified / not_verified / ...), which says whether the trade capture for this subject is proven complete.

realized_sol.description: Known realizations only; see unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol and completeness.

unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol.description: Cost basis of FIFO lots consumed by disposals whose realization is unknown. It left the open positions and is NOT in realized_sol (neither a loss nor a gain). 0 when complete.

tips_sol.description: Migration 516 (present only once settlement reads are enabled server-side; not yet): proven SOL tips inside the cost basis (buys) or deducted from the proceeds (sells) above. A tip enters only when the wallet has exactly one stored trade in that transaction; otherwise it is in notes.unallocated_tx_costs.

profit_factor.description: Gross wins / gross losses. null if no losses (undefined math).

pnl_curve.description: Sparse daily UTC buckets — only days with at least one realized event are returned.

closed_positions.description: Tokens where the wallet's position has been fully closed AND there was an observable buy in window. Sorted by pnl_sol DESC (winners first).

cost_basis_observable_from.description: Cost basis can only be reconstructed from trades inside our data window. Overflow sells (no matching buy in window) are silently discarded rather than fabricated.

trades_through.description: Newest trade included — the cache watermark (a later trade invalidates the cached analysis)

trades_through_same_second.description: Trades at exactly trades_through_block_time that were included (block_time is second-granular; used to detect a same-second trade ingested after the compute)

partial.description: Present (true) only when the wallet exceeded the trade analysis cap and the summary was computed from the most recent trades only.

analyzed_trades.description: Present only when partial is true — the number of most-recent trades the summary was computed from (the cap).

partial_reason.description: Present only when partial is true — human-readable explanation of what the cap excludes (realized PnL for positions opened before cost_basis_observable_from; open positions limited to the analyzed window).

tokens.description: Tokens with sells beyond in-window buys; excluded from realized PnL.

unallocated_tx_costs.description: Migration 516 (present only once settlement reads are enabled server-side; not yet): proven SOL tips that are in no cost basis and no realized PnL, because the transaction carried two or more trades of this wallet (a tip is never split) or the trade's realization is unknown.

unknown_realizations.description: Disposals whose realized PnL is unknown (see completeness). Their consumed cost basis is reported here and excluded from every realized figure.

proceeds_unattributed_sells.description: Sells with price_status proceeds_unattributed (proceeds went to another wallet or reached nobody we can prove).

tokens.description: Tokens with at least one unknown disposal (realized_status partial or unknown).

holding_check.description: COV-21: summary of the proven-holding check over the returned open positions (SOLANA_POSITION_HOLDING; mode off = every position unverified/not_checked).

cache_hit.description: true when served from wallet_analyses cache

computed_at.description: Always returned — when the analysis was computed (the fresh compute time on a miss, the cached row's analyzed_at on a hit)

cache_age_seconds.description: Seconds since computed_at — the source age survives a cache hit (0 on a fresh compute)

cache_validation.description: Cache hits only (audit F16): head_checked = the wallet has no persisted trade newer than the analysis watermark, so the cached analysis is current; unverified = the trade-head probe failed and the unexpired cache was served flagged. A hit whose wallet traded after the watermark is never served — it is recomputed.

cache_invalidated.description: Present on a recompute that happened because a cached analysis existed but the wallet traded after it

ttl_seconds.description: Only present on cache misses — TTL for this row in wallet_analyses (5min / 1h / 24h based on activity)

cost_basis_sol.description: null when part of the position was bought with unknown consideration (cost_basis_status unknown): never computed against a 0 basis.

current_price_sol.description: Live from market-cap tracker. null if the mint has no current price (e.g. delisted).

position_basis.description: Positions are FIFO-open DEX buys from token_trades (trade position), not a proven holding.

cost_basis_status.description: partial = a verified balance exceeds the trade position; the excess arrived without a swap and has no cost basis. unknown = part of the position was bought with unknown consideration (event.price_status quote_unpriced): its tokens count, cost_basis_sol / avg_entry_price_sol / unrealized_* and the holding's cost values are null.

cost_basis_not_held_sol.description: Cost of FIFO lots no longer in the wallet (transfer out / unindexed disposal). Outcome unknown: neither realized nor unrealized. null when cost_basis_status is unknown.

roi_pct.description: realized_sol / total_bought_sol × 100; null when realized_status is not known

result.description: unknown = at least one disposal's realization is unknown (proceeds_unattributed / unknown consideration): not a win, not a loss, not counted in win_rate or profit_factor; sorted after the known positions

realized_status.description: known = every disposal realized; partial = some unknown (pnl_sol is the known part); unknown = only unknown disposals

unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol.description: Cost basis of the lots consumed by unknown disposals of this token; not in pnl_sol.

TradeRawAmounts.description: Exact on-chain amounts of this trade (#508). Present only once exact amounts are enabled server-side. Integers are decimal STRINGS (u64 base units exceed the JSON double range). `raw_known: false` = a row stored before exact amounts existed: every field is null = UNKNOWN, never 0. With `raw_known: true`: `token_raw` is the wallet's net change of the traded mint in base units (token_amount = token_raw / 10^token_decimals, exact — 1 base unit of a 9-decimal token is "1" here while token_amount rounds to 0); `sol_net_lamports` is the signed SOL settlement (negative = paid) with the tx fee and token-account rent EXCLUDED, null unless SOL is the proven settlement; `quote_*` is the one non-SOL token the wallet moved the other way (USDC, PUMP, an xStock …); both null = settlement unknown (never guessed).

token_raw.description: abs net change of the traded mint, base units

sol_net_lamports.description: signed lamports, fee + token-account rent excluded; null unless SOL is the proven settlement

quote_raw.description: abs net change of quote_mint, base units

raw_known.description: false = legacy row, every raw field null (unknown)

TradeEventFacts.description: Event identity and attribution labels of this trade row (migration 493). Present on /tokens/{mint}/trades and /wallet/{address}/trades once event reads are enabled server-side (live since 2026-10-16). Every field null = a netted legacy row: one row per (transaction, wallet, mint), the pre-493 shape: every row stored before `coverage.event_identity.events_from`, and every later trade whose swap legs were not proven exactly (event rows are written since 2026-10-21, partial coverage). Values are open-ended labels: treat an unrecognised value as not proven, never as a normal trade. Never deduplicate on (tx_signature, wallet_address): N event rows of one transaction share tx_signature and differ in event_id.

event_id.description: `signature:outer_ix[.inner_ix]` of the decoded swap instruction, plus `#h<k>` for hop k of a multi-hop instruction; stable, use it to deduplicate; null = netted row (one row for the wallet's whole net change of the mint in this transaction)

trader_status.description: signer | non_signer | unproven (a non-signer whose swap is proven by its legs but whose ownership is not: shown on the token tape, excluded from every wallet-scoped read and count); null = legacy row. Later labels may appear; only null, signer and non_signer count as the wallet's own trade.

price_status.description: null = priced as before | quote_unpriced (non-SOL quote leg without a price: sol_amount is the wallet's fee, not the consideration; price_sol / price_usd are null) | proceeds_unattributed (a sell whose proceeds went to another wallet or to nobody provable: token_amount counts, sol_amount is NOT the proceeds, price_sol / price_usd are null; not written until the attribution writer is enabled)

block_time_source.description: chain | ingest_clock (the live stream carries no block time, so block_time is our ingest clock); null = legacy row (ingest clock on the live path)

settlement.description: Migrations 515/516 (present only once settlement reads are enabled server-side; not yet): the proven economic settlement of this event row. null = netted row, or an event row with nothing proven beyond the event. Amounts are exact base-unit strings.

route.description: custody_fee | custody_forward | router_funded | split_parties | split_route (later: direct | pumpfun_multihop); null = no settlement route, only tips or fees

amount.description: The wallet's own economic settlement (router_funded: the funding it paid the router).

gross_token_amount_raw.description: custody_fee: pool-side gross token amount; the row's token amount stays the NET the wallet received.

pool_quote.description: The pool's own quote leg of the swap (the venue price), when it differs from the wallet's settlement.

fees.description: Proven fees of this event. Facts only: a router_fee or pumpswap_cashback fee is never part of the trade's amounts, price, volume, cost basis or PnL.

kind.description: funding_fee | route_fee_sol | router_fee | pumpswap_cashback (the PumpSwap cashback fee a routed buy of a cashback coin also paid, in the quote mint; reported separately)

program.description: router_fee / pumpswap_cashback only: the program that charged the fee.

recipient.description: router_fee: the fee's recipient account; pumpswap_cashback: the proven owner of the receiving account.

recipient_account.description: pumpswap_cashback only: the token account that received the fee.

payer.description: router_fee / pumpswap_cashback only: the payer when it is this trade's own wallet, else null (another party is never listed by address).

tips.description: Proven top-level SOL transfers by the wallet in this transaction (Jito / bot tips). Never part of the price.

tips_shared_by_events.description: The wallet's stored trades in this transaction. 1 = the tips are in this trade's PnL basis; 2 or more = unallocated (never split).

parties.description: Migrations 515/516 (present only once settlement reads are enabled server-side; not yet): roles the transaction proves for this event. wallet is set only for a proven signer; every other role is a fact without an address.

role.description: event_user | payer | recipient | fee_payer | funding_account | intermediary | fee_recipient

sol_amount.description: SOL moved by this trade (the wallet's net SOL movement, swap fee and account rent included). null = the SOL consideration is UNPROVEN: event.price_status is "quote_unpriced" (the proceeds or payment could not be attributed to this wallet in SOL, for example a sell whose SOL went to another account, or a token-settled trade whose quote could not be priced; the quote facts stay in amounts) or "proceeds_unattributed". 0 = a measured zero (for example a sell that recovered nothing). An unproven amount is never served as 0 (since 2026-10-28).

price_sol.description: This trade's executed price (sol_amount / token_amount); null on dust / zero-SOL legs

market_price_sol.description: mc-tracker's canonical pool price sampled near this trade's slot — not this trade's price

source_wallets_tracked.description: DEPRECATED 2026-10-04 (kept): source wallets that are tracked KOL wallets. Enrichment only under source_admission any_wallet; under kol_only only these can produce a signal. null when the tracking read failed. Since 2026-09-25.

source_wallets_untracked.description: DEPRECATED 2026-10-04 (kept): source wallets that are not tracked KOL wallets. They fire under source_admission any_wallet; under kol_only they never produce a signal.

warnings.description: Present only when something needs attention (untracked source wallets, tracking unavailable).

XRequestId.description: Unique id of this response. On responses built after authentication it is also the `request_id` of the audit-log row for the call, so quote it in a support request. Present on every response of the keyed API.

XRateLimitLimit.description: Size of the rate-limit window this call was counted against: the daily quota for your tier on data endpoints, the per-minute bucket on `/stream/token` (10) and `/stream/sessions` (30), the hourly allowance for the public demo key. Sent once the key has been authenticated and rate-limited, so it is absent on authentication-stage errors.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Calls left in that window. `0` on a quota 429.

XRateLimitUsed.description: Calls used in that window (`limit − remaining`).

XRateLimitReset.description: When the window resets, as a Unix epoch in SECONDS (next 00:00 UTC for the daily quota; about 60 s ahead for a per-minute bucket).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (RFC 9110 delay-seconds, at least 1). Sent on every 429 (quota, concurrency, authentication-failure) and every 503; when the body carries `retry_after_seconds` it is the same value.

XDataDelay.description: Free-tier only: the feed in this body is delayed by this many seconds (same value as the body's `delay_seconds`). Absent on real-time responses.

XMadeOnSolQuotaWarning.description: Free-tier only, past about 70 % of the daily quota: a human-readable usage line with an upgrade link.
XMadeOnSolQuotaWarning.example: 150/200 used - upgrade for 50x higher limits: https://madeonsol.com/checkout?tier=PRO

BadRequest.description: Invalid path or query parameter, or an invalid request body.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API key, or an expired free-tier key. Authentication-stage error: no `X-RateLimit-*` headers, no `_rid`.

value.error: Missing authentication — use API key (Authorization: Bearer msk_...)
value.hint: Get a free API key — 200 calls/day, no payment
Get a free API key — 200 calls/day, no payment

TierForbidden.description: Forbidden. One of: the key's tier is below this endpoint's or parameter's gate (`tier_required` with an `upgrade` block); the public demo key used outside its allow-list (`demo_key_endpoint_not_allowed`); an invalid or revoked key; an origin-restricted key called from a disallowed origin (`code` `origin_not_allowed` / `origin_required`). `X-RateLimit-*` headers are present only on `tier_required`.

value.message: This endpoint requires ULTRA tier — you're on PRO.

The public demo key works on /kol/feed, /deployer-hunter/alerts, and /alpha/leaderboard only. This endpoint requires the PRO plan or higher; a free API key will not unlock it. See https://madeonsol.com/pricing.

NotFound.description: The addressed resource does not exist or is not yours.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing state (e.g. a duplicate or a per-tier limit on stored rules).

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Every 429 carries `Retry-After`. A quota 429 (`rate_limit_exceeded`, with `X-RateLimit-*`), a heavy-query concurrency 429 (`error_kind` `concurrency`/`capacity`), or the per-IP authentication-failure block (30 failed auths/min; plain `error` + `retry_after_seconds`, no `X-RateLimit-*`).

value.message: Daily rate limit exceeded — 200/day for BASIC tier. Resets at midnight UTC.

concurrency.summary: Too many heavy queries in flight

value.error: Too many concurrent heavy queries. Up to 8 of these endpoints may be in flight at once per key — retry in a moment, or lower your request concurrency.
Too many authentication failures from this IP. Retry in 60s.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error from the route (`Internal server error`, with `_rid`). Safe to retry with backoff. A failed API-key lookup is a 503 `auth_backend_unavailable`, never a 500.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Temporarily unavailable — a Postgres statement timeout while the dataset is under load or maintenance (`statement_timeout`, with `X-RateLimit-*` and `_rid`), or the API-key lookup itself unavailable (`auth_backend_unavailable`, authentication stage: no `X-RateLimit-*`, no `_rid`, not counted as a failed authentication). Always carries `Retry-After`; honour it.

value.error: Query timed out — this dataset is under load or being maintained. Retry shortly.

AuthBackendUnavailable.description: The API-key or subscription lookup could not be answered (authentication stage). Retryable and not your fault: it is never counted as a failed authentication. Honour `Retry-After`; no `X-RateLimit-*`, no `_rid`.

get.description: Returns the calling subscriber's tier, daily/burst quota state, subscription expiry, and per-feature usage counts (webhooks, copy-trade wallets, coordination rules, watchlist). Available to every authenticated tier — use this to verify your key works and read remaining daily quota without parsing rate-limit headers.

get.summary: KOL trade feed on Robinhood Chain (BASIC+; 5-min delay on free)
get.description: Every buy/sell from tracked Solana KOLs' verified EVM wallets on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663), attributed to the effective trading account from our self-hosted node (tx.from normally, or the ERC-4337 userOp sender when bundled — never the bundler) — DEX swaps and launchpad curve snipes, within seconds of execution on PRO and up (the free tier serves this feed on a 5-minute delay). The KOL→EVM mapping is recovered by tracing each KOL's Solana→EVM bridge deposits (deBridge / Relay / Mayan / Wormhole) — a dataset unique to MadeOnSol. Every row is enriched with the token's current MC/liquidity/peak, the deployer's reputation tier, and `mc_multiple_since_trade` (current MC ÷ MC when the KOL bought — 'did the call run'). Tier: **BASIC** (any valid key).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor: return trades strictly older than this ISO timestamp. Pass `next_before` from the previous response to page backwards.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: PREFERRED pagination (audit F09 follow-up): the `next_cursor` from a previous page — an opaque strict (traded_at, id) keyset, so paging never repeats or skips rows that share a timestamp and progresses with limit=1 through runs of identical timestamps. Malformed or tampered → 400. Cannot be combined with `before=` (400); `before=` stays supported as the legacy bound.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Only buys or only sells.

parameters.name: kol
parameters.description: Filter to a single KOL by their EVM wallet address (0x, 40 hex).

parameters.name: min_eth
parameters.description: Minimum trade size in ETH.

parameters.name: exclude_sells
parameters.description: Convenience alias for `action=buy` — drops sells from the feed. Ignored if `action` is set explicitly.

parameters.name: min_mc_usd
parameters.description: Only trades where the token's market cap at trade time was at least this (USD).

parameters.name: max_mc_usd
parameters.description: Only trades where the token's market cap at trade time was at most this (USD). Combine with `min_mc_usd` for a band; `min_mc_usd` must be <= `max_mc_usd` or the request 400s.

parameters.name: token_age_max_min
parameters.description: Only trades on tokens first seen at most this many minutes ago — the 'fresh launches KOLs are buying' filter. Tokens with unknown first-seen time are excluded.

parameters.name: min_kol_winrate
parameters.description: Only trades by KOLs whose 7-day win rate (mv_rhc_kol_scores.winrate_7d, CLOSED positions only — sold ≥ 90 % of bought) is at least this (0–1). KOLs with no closed positions have a NULL win rate and are dropped, so `min_kol_winrate=0` is NOT a no-op: it means "scored".

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: Only trades by KOLs in this hold-time bucket (mv_rhc_kol_scores.strategy). An RHC-specific bucket, not Solana's auto_strategy_tag.

200.description: `chain` echoes `robinhood`; `next_before` is the pagination cursor; `data_age_seconds` is the age of the newest row.

launchpad.description: pons | flap | clanker | hood.fun | virtuals | null.

deployer_tier.description: Reputation tier of the token's deployer.

token_age_minutes.description: Token age at request time (first-seen → now).

market_cap_usd_at_trade.description: Token market cap when the KOL traded.

peak_mc_usd.description: All-time-high market cap observed since ingestion.

liquidity_basis.description: How liquidity_usd was derived. uniswap-v4 has no per-pool balances, so its figure is virtual reserves clamped to the PoolManager's total holdings — a provable CEILING, not measured per-pool TVL. All other venues are measured from real balances.

mc_multiple_since_trade.description: current_mc_usd ÷ market_cap_usd_at_trade — how far the token ran after the KOL's trade.

dex.description: uniswap-v2/v3/v4 or the launchpad name for curve trades.

kol_score.description: The KOL's row in mv_rhc_kol_scores. null = no row yet (too few closed positions), never "not looked up".

strategy.description: Hold-time bucket: scalper | day_trader | swing | inactive | unscored.

filtered_by.description: Echo of the KOL-score filters (null = not applied).

matched_kols.description: KOLs matching min_kol_winrate/strategy; null when neither filter is set.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next (older) page — pass as `cursor=`. PREFERRED over next_before, which is a strict timestamp bound that skips same-timestamp siblings of the boundary row.

has_more.description: false only when the feed is exhausted (not merely when the page is short).

scan.description: Present when a filter had to be applied after the candidate fetch (audit F09): has_more is then false only when the candidates ran out, and scan_truncated=true means the per-request scan budget ran out first — more matches MAY exist past next_cursor.

scan_truncated.description: The per-request scan budget ran out before `limit` matches — more matches MAY exist past the cursor/offset

get.summary: Scout KOL leaderboard on Robinhood Chain (PRO+)
get.description:
Robinhood Chain port of `GET /kol/scouts/leaderboard` (2026-10-15). A first touch is a KOL buy of a token no KOL bought before (chain order). Per KOL: first touches in the last 30 days that are at least 4 hours old, how many other KOLs bought within 4 hours (`avg_followers_4h`), and the share that drew ≥3 / ≥5 (`swarm_3plus_pct` / `swarm_5plus_pct`). `scout_tier` S ≥ 40 / A ≥ 25 / B ≥ 15 / C on `swarm_3plus_pct`, null below 30 first touches.

Differences from Solana: identity is the KOL (a KOL with several EVM addresses is one scout and never its own follower; `evm_addresses` lists them), and KOLs below `min_first_touches` (default 30) are left out instead of listed with a null tier. Computed point in time as of `as_of` (no MV), cached 5 minutes. 503 `scout_scores_unavailable` when the score cannot be computed (never an empty ranking).

get.description:
Every Uniswap v2/v3/v4 swap on chain 4663 from our self-hosted node, within seconds of execution. Each row carries the **real trader wallet** (`trader_eoa` — the userOp sender on ERC-4337 transactions, never the router or the bundler), gas/ordering for MEV analysis, pool state, and flags for whether the trader is a tracked KOL or a known deployer. Cursor via `next_before`. Tier: **PRO+**.

**Where the rows come from** (*added 2026-08-29*): closed months older than the newest three move from Postgres to a Parquet archive; pages are split at `history.postgres_from` (ISO) — rows at/after it from Postgres, older rows from the archive reader, same ordering and `before` cursor. `history.archive_used`, `archive_months`, `archive_available` (`null` = not configured) and `truncated` (older history requested but the archive did not answer — retry rather than treating `has_more:false` as the end) mirror `/tokens/{mint}/trades`. Header `X-Read-Source`: `core`, `core+archive` or `archive`.

parameters.description: Candle timeframe, rolled up server-side from the 1-minute base series. Also accepted as `timeframe`, `interval` or `resolution` (`tf` wins, then in that order). parameters.description: Same as `tf`; read only when `tf` is absent.

parameters.description: Same as `interval`; read only when `tf`, `timeframe` and `interval` are absent. An unknown value is a 400.

parameters.description: Lower bound on bucket_start (inclusive). If neither `from` nor `to` is given, the window is anchored on the token's most recent candle — so quiet tokens still return their last `limit` candles.

parameters.description: Upper bound on bucket_start (exclusive).
