open_bucket_start.description: Added 2026-11-07. Start of the bucket that contains as_of, on the same UTC grid as the candles (epoch origin). A candle with t at or after it is still OPEN and will change; earlier candles are closed (a closed 1-minute candle can still be revised by a late trade, see the revised events on the live candle channel).

gap_fill.description: Added 2026-11-07. Only stored candles are returned; a bucket with no stored candle is absent and never synthesized (no forward-filled close, no invented zero volume). A stored candle can have trades = 0 and volume_usd = 0 when the price moved without a trade.

get.summary: KOL consensus on a Robinhood Chain token (PRO+)
get.description: How the tracked-KOL cohort is positioned on a token: distinct KOL buyers vs sellers, exit rate (bought AND sold), net ETH flow, median entry MC, and first-touch wallet/time. Full parity with the Solana `/tokens/{mint}/kol-consensus` (sourced from `rhc_kol_trades`), EVM-denominated (`net_flow_eth`). ULTRA additionally returns the `buyers` and `exited` wallet lists. Tier: **PRO+**.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (0x, 40 hex).

200.description: OK. `consensus` is null when no tracked KOL has traded the token.

kol_exit_rate.description: Fraction of KOL buyers who also sold (0–1).

median_entry_mc_usd.description: Median MC at KOL buy — over the buys that carried an MC-at-trade (see entry_mc_samples). Null when the RHC pricer withheld MC under its liquidity gate.

entry_mc_samples.description: Number of buys with a market_cap_usd_at_trade — the median's sample size.

buyers.description: ULTRA only — distinct KOL buyer wallets.

exited.description: ULTRA only — KOL wallets that bought and sold.

get.summary: Early-buyer quality on a Robinhood Chain token (BASIC+)
get.description: A 0–100 quality read on a token's earliest distinct buyer cohort (first 20), derived live from `rhc_trades` and enriched with `mv_rhc_alpha_wallets` history. Full parity with the Solana scorer: win-rate, KOL-presence, bot-domination and **bundle-buyer** legs (a bundled early buyer in the top 10 costs −5; a heavily bundled cohort of >10 costs −15), plus the **dump-cluster ensemble** — `dump_cluster_count` counts early buyers that repeatedly sit in launches that crashed off their own peak (rolling 42-day model, out-of-sample validated on RHC). Dump-cluster is **informational**: it flags the pattern but does not move the score. Tier: **BASIC** (any valid key).

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (0x, 40 hex).

parameters.name: include_balances
parameters.description: PRO+ (2026-10-15): add `dump_cluster_held_now`, the current balanceOf(token) of the early buyers counted in dump_cluster_count (one Multicall3 batch on our node). The base response is unchanged.

200.description: OK. Neutral score (50) with `note` when the token has no buyer history yet.

cohort_selection.description: distinct_first_buy = the first 20 DISTINCT buyer EOAs by their first buy (block, tx index, log index), selected before the limit. legacy_row_window = pre-rhc/011 fallback (oldest 300 buy rows, deduped — a repeat buyer can crowd out later distinct buyers); served only until that migration is applied.

dump_cluster_held_now.description: Only with include_balances=true (PRO+, 2026-10-15, TR-09): the early buyers counted in dump_cluster_count and what they hold NOW from balances. Totals only when every member was read.

members.description: Dump-cluster members among the early buyers (= dump_cluster_count).

held_now.description: Same shape as the bundle held_now of this chain: source, checked_at, wallets, verified_wallets, holding_wallets, complete, incomplete_reason, tokens_held_raw, tokens_held, held_pct_of_supply (ratio), supply_basis.

confidence.description: Confidence in the PREDICTIVE inputs: counts only buyers whose win rate fed the score (≥3 tokens of history, not bot-flagged, not zero-cost-dump dominated). insufficient_data = none did — the score is the neutral-50 default plus penalties. 1 → low, 5+ → medium, 11+ → high.

wallets_with_history.description: Buyers with ≥3 tokens of history (cohort identification — not predictive)

qualified_win_rate_wallets.description: Buyers whose win rate fed the score — the basis of confidence

bundle_buyer_count.description: Early buyers flagged as part of a same-block launch bundle (mig 255).

dump_cluster_count.description: Early buyers on the rolling dump-cluster list (≥5 crashed-off-peak cohorts, 0 runner cohorts, trailing 42d, OOS-validated). Informational — high count = strong dump signal.

recycled_early_buyer_count.description: Early buyers with ≥5 recent early-buyer appearances of any kind (dump_cluster_count is a subset).

avg_historical_win_rate.description: Percent (0–100), non-bot buyers with ≥3 tokens of history.

coverage.description: Signal availability. Dump-cluster is available but informational (does not move the score).

earliest_buyers_caveat.description: For launches before 2026-07-18 the earliest-buyers cohort is the earliest 20 ATTRIBUTED buyers (trader_eoa backfill pending), not necessarily the first 20 buyers.

note.description: Present only when buyer data is insufficient.

get.summary: Share of supply held now by all bundle wallets on a Robinhood Chain token (PRO+)
get.description: ONE figure for a terminal (2026-10-15): `bundled_pct_of_supply_now`, the share of total supply held RIGHT NOW by every bundle wallet: the launch bundle plus every wallet of a coordinated buy cluster in the window (`/rhc/tokens/{address}/bundles`), each wallet counted once, balanceOf from our node in one Multicall3 batch (at most 500 wallets). Null when not every wallet could be read. Cached 30 seconds per token, shared by every caller (`as_of`). Before hood rhc/039 is applied it counts the launch bundle only (`scope: launch_cohort_only`).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Which later clusters to include (the launch bundle is always included).

bundled_pct_of_supply_now.description: RATIO in [0, 1]: the BROAD same-slot (Solana) / same-block (Robinhood Chain) HEURISTIC: share of supply held now by the launch bundle plus EVERY buyer in a slot/block with min_wallets+ distinct buyers in the window. On busy tokens many of those buyers share a slot by chance, so this is an upper-bound style heuristic, NOT a count of proven bundles and not comparable to third-party 'bundler' figures. Prefer strict_bundle_pct_of_supply_now for the proven measure. Null unless the wallet set is known complete (clusters_complete true) AND every wallet was read (see held_now.incomplete_reason). Value semantics unchanged since 2026-10-15.

bundled_pct_basis.description: Names what bundled_pct_of_supply_now measures (2026-11-11): the broad same-slot / same-block heuristic.

strict_bundle_pct_of_supply_now.description: RATIO in [0, 1] (2026-11-11): the STRICT measure, a PROVEN LOWER BOUND: share of supply held now by the launch bundle plus the same-slot buyers that share ONE transaction with another buyer. Nothing else admits a wallet (an identical buy amount is not evidence; a funding link only counts between two wallets already in the set, so it never adds one). Bundles that used separate transactions are not counted. Same balance read and supply as bundled_pct_of_supply_now. Null with strict_bundle.incomplete_reason when not known (never 0 for unknown). Always null on Robinhood Chain (not_supported_on_chain).

strict_bundle.description: How the strict measure was computed (2026-11-11; admission tightened the same day to launch bundle + same transaction).

definition.description: Was launch_bundle_plus_linked_same_slot_buyers (identical amount and funding admitted wallets) until the 2026-11-11 tightening.

basis.description: The strict figure is a lower bound: every wallet in it is proven, but not every bundle wallet is proven.

funding_evidence_since.description: Funding data (wallet_funding_links, funding_context) only exists since this date.

status.description: unavailable = the strict wallet-set function is not deployed (latched 5 minutes); not_supported = no strict evidence on this chain.

incomplete_reason.description: Why there is no strict figure: strict_function_unavailable, strict_wallet_set_timeout, strict_wallet_set_error, strict_rule_outdated (the server still runs the looser pre-tightening rule), strict_wallet_set_truncated, wallet_set_unavailable, not_supported_on_chain, not_every_wallet_read, supply_unknown, census_subset_unavailable, or the held_now.incomplete_reason of the shared balance read.

linked_cluster_wallets.description: Same-transaction same-slot wallets not already in the launch cohort.

evidence.description: Admission evidence per type. Since the 2026-11-11 tightening only same_transaction_wallets admits wallets; identical_amount_wallets and funding_link_wallets are kept for compatibility and are always null.

funding_context.description: Context only, admits nothing: strict wallets with a wallet_funding_links edge to another strict wallet. Funding data only exists since funding_evidence_since, so 0 for an older launch means no data, not no link.

scope.description: launch_cohort_only = the cluster function was not available; only the launch bundle is counted.

clusters_complete.description: True only when every coordinated buy cluster in the window was read: clusters_status ok AND fewer than clusters_limit clusters came back. False when the cluster list hit clusters_limit (older clusters in the window may be missing; held_now.incomplete_reason clusters_truncated) or the cluster function was not available (scope launch_cohort_only). bundled_pct_of_supply_now is null whenever this is false (2026-10-15).

clusters_limit.description: Most clusters read per request (200). A response with this many clusters is treated as possibly truncated.

held_now.description: Same shape as the bundle held_now of this chain. incomplete_reason adds clusters_truncated (the cluster list hit clusters_limit; balances are not read) next to cluster_wallets_truncated (a cluster has more wallets than the 50 listed).

503.description: Temporarily unavailable

get.summary: Every coordinated buy cluster on a Robinhood Chain token, launch and later (PRO+)
get.description: Every block in the window where at least `min_wallets` distinct effective trading accounts (ERC-4337 senders resolved) bought the token, the launch bundle AND clusters that enter later (2026-10-15). `/rhc/tokens/{address}/bundle` remains the launch-cohort view. Per cluster: block, time, `minutes_after_launch` + `phase`, `wallet_count`, `new_wallets`, `same_tx_groups` (transactions carrying 3+ of them; weaker than on Solana because a 4337 bundler batches unrelated userOps into one tx), ETH volume, `token_volume_raw` (uint256 string), wallets. No size floor on Robinhood Chain. `include_balances=true` adds `held_now` (balanceOf from our node) to the 3 most recent clusters.

parameters.name: min_wallets
parameters.description: Minimum distinct buyers in one slot/block to count as a cluster.

parameters.name: include_balances
parameters.description: Add `held_now` (current balances from the chain) to the 3 most recent clusters.

200.description: OK. An empty clusters array means no slot/block in the window had min_wallets distinct buyers.

baseline.description: Window baseline (null when no cluster was found): active units, buys in window, buys per active unit. On busy tokens unrelated buyers share slots.

new_wallets.description: Buyers with no earlier buy of this token.

held_now.description: Only with include_balances=true, on the 3 most recent clusters: same shape as the bundle held_now of this chain; totals only when every wallet was read.

exit.description: What this cluster's wallets have SOLD of the token since the cluster (bundle-watch sell ledger, migration 503). null = not followed (only clusters bundle-watch announced: >= 3 wallets new to the token; followed 7 days after detection; first 50 wallets).

sold_pct.description: Sum over wallets of min(sold, bought in the cluster) / bought in the cluster, 0..1.

realized_status.description: Migration 511: incomplete when at least one recorded sell has unknown proceeds (Solana price_status proceeds_unattributed, or no quote amount); its tokens count in sold_pct, its proceeds are NOT in realized_eth (never booked as 0). null = not measured (ledger before migration 511).

unknown_proceeds_sells.description: Recorded sells with unknown proceeds (see realized_status).

exit_tracking.description: Whether the exit ledger could be read; the clusters are served either way (exit null when not ok).

503.description: bundle_clusters_unavailable (SQL function not applied) or bundle_clusters_temporarily_unavailable (timeout).

get.summary: Launch-bundle detection on a Robinhood Chain token (BASIC+)
get.description: Detects a coordinated launch bundle in a token's earliest-buyer cohort and measures how much of what the bundle bought it still holds. Mirrors the Solana `/tokens/{mint}/bundle` detector: rank the first 20 distinct buyers by on-chain order, flag a bundle when 3+ of them make their first buy in the **same block**, then report the cohort's current-held %. Robinhood Chain is an Arbitrum Orbit L2 with no atomic multi-signer transaction, so there is no `atomic_tx` kind — a detected bundle is `same_block` (else `none`). Scores tokens ingested live (the near-launch window where bundling happens). Field-gated by tier: **BASIC** gets the scalar `bundle` signal only; **PRO** adds the top-10 wallets; **ULTRA** returns the full cohort enriched with alpha-wallet identity (win-rate, bot, KOL).

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (0x, 40 hex).

parameters.name: include_balances
parameters.description: PRO+ (2026-10-15): add `held_now`, the cohort's CURRENT balanceOf(token) from one Multicall3 batch on our own node, and `balance_now` per disclosed wallet. Totals only when every cohort wallet was read; never a partial sum.

200.description: OK. `wallet_count` 0 with `bundle_kind: none` when no same-block early-buyer cluster is present.

bundle_kind.description: `same_block` = 3+ early buyers first-bought in one block; `none` = no cluster. `atomic_tx` does not exist on EVM.

held_ratio.description: Net tokens still held ÷ tokens bought, [0,1]. The primary signal.

held_pct_of_supply.description: Net tokens held ÷ total supply, [0,1]; null when supply is unknown.

fully_exited.description: True when the cohort holds ≤0.5% of what it bought.

holdings_basis.description: swap_only = token transfers are not applied: a member that transferred tokens out and sold elsewhere still reads as holding.

held_now.description: Only with include_balances=true (PRO+). Balance-based, next to the swap-derived bundle.* figures.

complete.description: True only when every cohort wallet was read.

tokens_held_raw.description: Exact uint256 sum; null unless complete.

held_pct_of_supply.description: RATIO in [0, 1] of total_supply_raw (like bundle.held_pct_of_supply); null unless complete and supply known.

wallets.description: Empty for BASIC; top-10 for PRO; full cohort for ULTRA.

is_kol.description: Wallet is a tracked RHC KOL.

balance_now.description: Only with include_balances=true: this wallet's current balanceOf(token) from our node; unverified never means zero.

likely_bot.description: ULTRA only — bot heuristic from mv_rhc_alpha_wallets.

get.summary: Top traders of a Robinhood Chain token, ranked by observed net ETH flow (PRO+)
get.description: Ranks wallets by observed ETH received from sales minus ETH spent on buys for one token. This is cashflow, not profit: a wallet can sell tokens received elsewhere, and a wallet still holding tokens can have negative flow. The separate `fifo.realized_pnl_eth` field estimates profit only for sales with an observed earlier purchase; `pnl_coverage` describes that profit field, not the cashflow ranking. A null `buy_eth` means no qualifying buy was observed in the stored trade rows, not proof of missing ingestion. Wallet reputation, dump-cluster membership and early-buyer rank are included. **PRO** returns up to 50 rows; **ULTRA/BUSINESS** up to 200.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (0x, 40 hex).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows to return. Capped at 50 on PRO, 200 on ULTRA/BUSINESS.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip.

200.description: OK. `traders` is empty for a token with no attributed traders yet — a 200, not an error.

buy_eth.description: Observed ETH spent on buys. Null when no qualifying buy was observed in the stored trade rows; this alone does not prove missing data.

net_eth.description: Observed sell_eth − buy_eth, treating a missing side as zero. Cashflow, not profit or current holdings value.

avg_trade_mc.description: Mean market cap at time of trade (USD).

kol_name.description: Null when the KOL is tracked but unnamed.

wallet_net_eth.description: Trader's net across ALL tokens, for context.

dump_cohorts.description: Dump-cluster cohort count; >0 means recycled dumper.

early_buyer_rank.description: 1–20 when this trader was an early buyer.

fifo.description: FIFO realized PnL on this token, computed the way `/rhc/wallet/{address}/pnl` computes it: sells match only earlier buys in chain order; tokens sold without an observed buy are `unmatched_sell_tokens` and never profit. Window: the token's whole stored history (`/pnl` reads the wallet's last 90 days). Open lots are not valued (a FIFO-open lot is not a verified balance). Null when `fifo_status` is not `ok`.

roi.description: realized / matched cost basis. Null when nothing was matched.

bought_eth.description: ETH spent on the trades FIFO used (sized + priced).

unmatched_sell_tokens.description: Tokens sold without an earlier observed buy (transfers in, pre-attribution buys). Excluded from realized PnL.

fifo_open_tokens.description: FIFO-open quantity. NOT a verified balance.

unpriced_trades.description: Trades without an ETH leg or direction: excluded.

unsized_trades.description: Trades whose token quantity could not be reconstructed: excluded.

pnl_coverage.description: Applies only to fifo.realized_pnl_eth: complete when every included sell has an observed cost and no trade is unpriced or unsized; partial means some profit is unknown; unavailable means no FIFO row was returned. It does not grade the cashflow ranking or prove an ingestion defect.

ranking_metric.description: Ordering is observed cashflow, not FIFO PnL.

fifo_status.description: `ok` = computed; `unavailable` = not deployed yet; `timeout` = too slow right now; `error` = failed. The ranking and the other fields never depend on it.

attribution.description: Interim attribution disclosure: the underlying rollup filters `trader_eoa IS NOT NULL`, and trader_eoa was only written reliably from 2026-07-18, so pre-floor history is not reflected. Removed once the trader_eoa backfill lands.

400.description: Invalid EVM token address, or bad limit/offset.

get.summary: Net buy/sell flow by trader cohort on a Robinhood Chain token (PRO+)
get.description:
Splits a token's trade flow into mutually-exclusive trader cohorts over a window, so you can see *who* is accumulating and *who* is distributing.

**Sign convention: `net_eth = sell − buy`.** Positive means the cohort **distributed** (took ETH out); negative means it **accumulated**. Cohorts are assigned by a priority ladder and each trader lands in exactly one: `kol` → `bot` → `dump_cluster` → `early_buyer` → `unprofiled` → `smart_money` → `retail`.

`smart_money` is derived (win-rate ≥ 0.5 and net positive across all tokens), not a stored label. `unprofiled` is a real answer, not a gap — the trader has not met the reputation matview's thresholds. There is deliberately no `fresh_wallet` cohort: Robinhood Chain has no wallet-level first-seen, so it cannot be computed honestly.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (0x, 40 hex).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Lookback window.

200.description: OK. `cohorts` is empty when the token had no trades in the window.

totals.description: Sum across cohorts; always equals the parts.

attribution.description: Interim attribution disclosure: cohort figures are computed from attributed trades only (`trader_eoa IS NOT NULL`), and trader_eoa was only written reliably from 2026-07-18 — pre-floor history is not reflected. Removed once the trader_eoa backfill lands.

400.description: Invalid EVM token address, or window not in {1h,6h,24h,7d}.

get.summary: Peak market cap, drawdown and high-water curve for a Robinhood Chain token (PRO+)
get.description:
Peak market cap, current drawdown from peak, and a running high-water curve.

**Two peaks are returned, and they can disagree.** `peak_mc_usd_recorded` is the stored high-water mark every other Robinhood Chain surface keys off (deployer runner-rate, the $40K graduation bar). `peak_mc_usd_observed` is the maximum of the 1-minute candle highs — trade-level truth, and always ≥ the recorded value. The recorded figure is sampled from write batches so it can undercount an intra-batch spike; both are surfaced rather than silently swapping one for the other, which would desync this endpoint from deployer tiering.

Candle history begins 2026-07-15, so a token that peaked earlier cannot have its peak reconstructed — `observed_covers_full_history` tells you whether the observed figure spans the token's whole life. Curve binning is chosen server-side (1m→4h) to keep the series bounded.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (0x, 40 hex).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Curve window.

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: Set false to skip the series and return only the peak summary.

current.description: Live market cap, liquidity, price, FDV.

observed_covers_full_history.description: False when candle history starts after the token did.

400.description: Invalid EVM token address, or bad window.

404.description: Token not found on Robinhood Chain.

get.summary: EVM-native risk assessment for a Robinhood Chain token (PRO+)
get.description:
Risk assessment computed **live** against our own Robinhood Chain node at the chain head.

**This is not the Solana risk model.** EVM has no mint or freeze authority. Measured across 300 random Robinhood Chain tokens, only 2.3% even expose an `owner()` function and 0% expose `mint` in their own bytecode — so an absent flag is the norm, not a safety signal. The axes that actually discriminate here are proxy upgradeability, LP custody, and sellability.

**Sellability is the strongest signal.** A sell is simulated through the router at head using state overrides, which detects a token that can be bought but not sold. It is computed live, never cached — whether a token is sellable can change the moment an owner flips a setting.

Proxies are resolved before capability scanning: EIP-1167 minimal proxies (14% of tokens) carry zero selectors of their own, and the tokenized equities are beacon proxies whose *implementation* is what exposes `mint`/`pause`/`upgradeTo`. `lp_custody` is only read for uniswap-v2 pools; v3/v4 liquidity sits in an LP NFT whose custody needs a position-manager trace, and is reported `unknown` rather than guessed.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (0x, 40 hex).

200.description: OK. Absent capability flags are the norm on this chain and are not a safety guarantee.

upgradeable.description: False for eip1167_minimal — the target is baked into immutable code.

model.description: `none` = no owner function at all, which is NOT the same as renounced.

lp_custody.description: Read for uniswap-v2 pools only, from the share of LP tokens at the burn addresses: >= 99 % burned = `burned`, below 99 % = `unknown` (the rest is not proven burned or locked: no lock contract is read; until 2026-11-11 50-99 % was wrongly reported `locked` and under 50 % `at_risk`). `locked` and `at_risk` need a lock read and are produced only by the lock-aware custody model (`liquidity.custody_detail`, not enabled yet). Any other venue = `unknown` and `assessment.not_assessed` contains `lp_custody`.

custody_detail.description: Lock-aware uniswap-v2 LP custody (burned + active verified locks capped by the locker's LP balance at one block). Present only when the server flag RHC_LP_CUSTODY_V2 is on; not enabled yet. See docs/rhc-lp-custody.md.

last_removed_at.description: Most recent LP withdrawal observed on this token (uniswap-v2/v3 `Burn`, uniswap-v4 negative `ModifyLiquidity`). `null` means none seen since removal capture began on 2026-08-05 — not that none ever happened.

sellable.description: Simulated through the router of the token's own venue (uniswap-v3 SwapRouter02; uniswap-v2 Router02 for WETH pairs; uniswap-v4 Universal Router with a hash-proven PoolKey via Permit2; Pons V2 bonding curves) after the route and the state override are proven; a v4 pool whose hook has no pinned real sell, and any other venue, is `unknown`, never `no` (since 2026-11-11). For v4 and Pons the output is measured from the transfer trace; a Pons revert is `unknown` (a graduated curve also reverts). `yes` holds only for the tested route, amount and block.

simulation.description: What was tested (2026-11-11). null when no simulation was attempted (no probe with a balance, non-standard storage).

fee.description: uniswap-v3 pool fee read from the pool.

amount_in.description: Raw token units sold (1 % of the probe holder's balance).

block.description: Block every read and the swap were pinned to.

amount_out.description: uniswap-v3: amountOut returned. uniswap-v2: `>=N`, the sell succeeded with amountOutMin = half the router quote. uniswap-v4 / pons-v2: the amount transferred to the seller, measured from the transfer trace.

override_verified.description: The synthetic balance and allowance were read back under the same override.

flags.description: Derived from the FINAL values of the fields above: `sell_reverts` appears only when `sellability.sellable` is `no` (a simulated revert contradicted by real sells is `unknown` and carries no flag and no deduction, since 2026-11-11). Includes `lp_removed_24h` when liquidity was withdrawn from this token in the last 24 hours.

score.description: 0–100, conservative: 100 minus the points of each flag (sell_reverts 60, mintable 20, upgradeable 15, pausable 10, owner_is_eoa 10, lp_not_locked 10; lp_removed_24h unscored). An unknown check removes no points, so with `assessment.status` incomplete the score is an upper bound. Absence of evidence is not evidence of safety.

assessment.description: Whether every input was actually read (2026-09-21). A failed read is an UNKNOWN input, never a silent all-clear: e.g. lp_removal_history unknown ⇒ the absence of `lp_removed_24h` proves nothing; observed_sells unknown ⇒ a simulated sell revert is reported sellable=unknown, not a honeypot.

unknown_inputs.description: Failed reads, plus (since 2026-11-11) checks whose final answer is unknown: `sellability` when sellable is unknown, `lp_custody` when a uniswap-v2 custody read was inconclusive.

not_assessed.description: Checks this model does not run for this token (LP custody on a non-uniswap-v2 pool). Not a failed read, and not a pass.

explanations.description: Plain-language reason per unknown or not-assessed key.

coverage.description: What this model does and does not read — see the endpoint description.

liquidity_basis.description: Basis of any liquidity_usd figure quoted for this token: uniswap-v4 values are virtual reserves clamped to the PoolManager's total holdings — a provable ceiling, not measured per-pool TVL.

get.summary: Every KOL trade on one Robinhood Chain token, with optional current balances (BASIC+)
get.description:
Every stored KOL trade on one Robinhood Chain token, newest first, in one payload (2026-10-15): KOL name, EVM address, side, ETH and token amounts, price and market cap at the trade, DEX, tx hash, log index, block and time. Keyset paging with `next_cursor` / exact `has_more`. Same tier depth as `/rhc/kol/feed` (BASIC: 5-minute delay, 20 rows).

**`include_balances=true` (PRO+)** adds `balances`: `balanceOf(token)` for every KOL address on the page, read in one Multicall3 batch from our own Robinhood Chain node at `checked_at`. A failed read is `status: unverified` with a `reason` and null balance, never a zero, and the balance is never reconstructed from trades (an open FIFO lot is not proof of a held balance).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: BASIC is clamped to 20.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only trades strictly after this time.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (keyset on traded_at DESC, id DESC).

parameters.name: kol
parameters.description: Only this KOL address.

parameters.name: include_balances
parameters.description: PRO+: current balanceOf(token) per KOL address on the page, from our node.

kols_on_page.description: Distinct KOL addresses on this page.

has_more.description: Exact (limit + 1 probe).

403.description: Tier gate - PRO required for include_balances.

429.description: Rate limited, or the heavy-query limiter refused the balance read.

503.description: Temporarily unavailable

get.summary: First buyers of a Robinhood Chain token, and whether they still hold (PRO+)
get.description:
The first buyers of a Robinhood Chain token, in order, joined to what happened next. `rhc_early_buyers` ranks the first 20 buyers of 437k tokens and is recomputed daily; until now it was read only as a per-wallet COUNT, never exposed as a per-token list. The Solana counterpart is `GET /kol/tokens/{mint}/entry-order`.

**`realized_eth` is observed sell-minus-buy ETH cashflow, NOT validated FIFO realized PnL.** Missing earlier buys, transfers and source gaps affect cost basis; read `position` and holding evidence separately.

**Default `still_holding`** requires a successful holder fold and a supply reconciliation. On failed/partial source it is null, not an invented exit. **Optional `verify_current_balances=true` (ULTRA+)** checks every ranked first buyer via `balanceOf` on the existing private Hood node at one pinned block with a matching block-hash recheck. If any RPC call, block check or the ranked cohort/statistics is unavailable, the **whole strict request fails (503)** rather than returning partially verified balances. Maximum 20 wallets; additional RPC is opt-in only. `holder_recon_block`/`holder_recon_checked_at` refer to the separate existing fold, not atomic chain-head balance proof.

**Ranks are as of `computed_at`, not live.** A token that began trading after the last sweep returns an empty list with a stated reason - never an assertion that it had no early buyers. Wallets may be ERC-4337 smart accounts, so a wallet is an address, not a person.

A failed read sets `scout_scores_status` and leaves the fields null, never the rest of the response.

still_holding.description: Null when the holder-table read, uint256 value, or supply reconciliation is unverified; never falsely infer exit.

balance.description: Raw uint256 as a decimal STRING, may be source-unverified.

get.summary: Holder set and concentration for a Robinhood Chain token (PRO+)
get.description:
Holder balances and concentration metrics. **Not trade-derived** — balances are folded from ERC-20 `Transfer` logs, which our node retains in full, so they are exact rather than estimated. The Solana counterpart is `GET /tokens/{mint}/holders` — a live on-chain census via mint-scoped getProgramAccounts (shipped 2026-08-16).

**Every token carries a reconciliation.** `verified` is true only when the reconstructed `sum(balance)` equals on-chain `totalSupply()` at a pinned block. A token that fails, or has not been swept yet, returns `verified: false` with a stated `unverified_reason` — never as though it were exact.

**Concentration excludes pools and burn addresses.** The largest holder of a token is normally its own liquidity pool, so counting it would make `top1_share` meaningless; pools and burns are reported separately as `pool_held_pct` / `burned_pct` and excluded from the circulating denominator. Balances are raw uint256 and are returned as **strings** to preserve precision. Holder addresses may be ERC-4337 smart accounts, so `holder_count` is not a headcount of people.

**Holder growth (2026-08-17).** `holder_growth.{1h,24h,7d}` reports `entered` (first Transfer at-or-after the window's `cutoff_block`), `entered_still_holding`, `exited` (pre-existing holders whose last movement in the window left them at zero) and `net` ≈ Δ holder_count — possible because the fold keeps first_seen_block/last_block and retains zero-balance rows. The Solana census has no history and cannot answer this.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (0x, 40 hex).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Capped at 50 on PRO, 200 on ULTRA/BUSINESS.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Position paging, capped at 10,000 (OFFSET is O(n)). For a full walk use `after`.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Keyset cursor (2026-09-05): pass the previous page's `next_after` unchanged to continue past the offset cap. Same order (balance DESC, holder ASC); supersedes offset. `next_after` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: include_wallet_flags
parameters.description: Opt in (TR-07) to per-holder `wallet_flags` + top-level `wallet_flags_meta`. Robinhood Chain: current holder page only; holders may be contracts or ERC-4337 accounts. Flags come from MadeOnSol's indexed wallet populations: a `false`/`null` with `label_coverage.evaluated=false` means insufficient evidence, NOT a verified negative. Any value other than true/false is a 400 (`invalid_include_wallet_flags`).

200.description: OK. Check `verified` before relying on the numbers.

verified.description: True only when reconstructed supply matches on-chain totalSupply().

share_basis.description: Plain-language denominator of each per-holder ratio (share, share_of_supply, share_of_circulating) and the burn addresses.

balance.description: Raw uint256 as a decimal STRING — not a number.

share.description: balance / non-burned supply (liquidity pools INCLUDED), [0,1]. null on burn rows (is_burn). Not the concentration basis: use share_of_circulating for that.

share_of_supply.description: balance / total folded supply (pools and burns included), [0,1]. Defined for every row, including burn and pool rows. null = unknown.

share_of_circulating.description: balance / circulating supply (pools and burns excluded), [0,1]: the same basis as concentration.top1_share. null on pool and burn rows, or when unknown.

wallet_flags.description: Only with include_wallet_flags=true; null for pools/burns, invalid addresses or unavailable sources. RHC has no sniper or wallet-level bundler classifier: those are always null.

label_coverage.description: Per label: evaluated=false means no sufficient evidence (not a verified negative).

next_after.description: Keyset cursor for the next page — pass it unchanged as `after`. null on the last page (or when the last row has no balance). Preferred over `offset` for full walks: offset is capped at 10,000, `after` is not.

after.description: Echo of the `after` cursor this page was read from (null on the first page).

holder_count.description: Holders with a positive balance, excluding liquidity pools and burn addresses. null (never 0) when we hold no fold data for the token or cannot place a 0 (see holder_count_status).

holder_count_status.description: measured = from the Transfer-log fold (a 0 here is proven: only pools/burns hold it); not_indexed = no positive balance in the fold at all, we hold no holder data for this token; unknown = a 0 on a later page that the page cannot place.

holder_growth.description: Entered / exited holders per window, read from first_seen_block + last_block of the Transfer-log fold (mig 325). null only if the growth read failed; a single window is null when the chain had no ingested trades in it (cutoff unresolvable).

history_coverage.description: Per-token history continuity of the Transfer-log fold (COV-24). Present only when the coverage read is enabled. `state`: `verified_interval` (fold proven continuous from the token's birth and reconciled), `recovery_pending` (a repair is rebuilding it), `partial_history` (folded only while tracked, a re-entry gap, failed/non-standard token, or the coverage read failed — `reason` says which). `recon_ok` alone is NOT proof of correct individual balances.

get.summary: Deployer signal alert feed on Robinhood Chain (BASIC+)
get.description:
The deployer alert feed on Robinhood Chain (from `rhc_deployer_alerts`) — new deploys and graduations from tracked deployers, newest first. RHC domain values differ from Solana: `tier` is elite | good | neutral | spammer, `priority` is high | medium, `alert_type` is new_deploy | graduated (RHC has no bonded/kol_buy alert types, and no KOL-buy enrichment).

**Two behaviours changed 2026-07-25.** (1) A tradability filter is now applied **BY DEFAULT** (`liquidity_usd >= $100`; unknown liquidity fails it) — the feed was serving alerts on tokens that had pumped and drained, one at $45K MC against $68 of liquidity. Pass `include_untradeable=true` for the raw tape; the active filter is echoed as `tradability_filter`. (2) `tier` and the `message` explaining it are now resolved at **READ time** from the live deployer rollup instead of being frozen at insert, so a demoted deployer can no longer be advertised as good-tier indefinitely. The original snapshot is preserved as `tier_at_alert`, with `tier_is_stale` flagging disagreement. Rows also carry `liquidity_usd` and `current_mc_usd`.

**Paging (2026-09-21, audit F09 follow-up):** the tradability and tier gates are served by a bounded SCAN over (event_at DESC, id DESC) — `has_more` is false only at the real end, `scan.scan_truncated` says the budget ran out first; page with `cursor=` (`next_cursor`). Alerts with a NULL event_at (none in production) are excluded.

Tier: **BASIC** (any valid key) — **ULTRA** gets the full requested `limit`, while BASIC/PRO share a 50-alert cap per request.

parameters.name: deployer_tier
parameters.description: Filter to one deployer reputation tier. Applied to the RESOLVED (read-time) tier, not the stored snapshot, so the filter and the reported `tier` always agree.

parameters.name: include_untradeable
parameters.description: Set true to disable the default liquidity_usd >= $100 tradability filter and receive the raw alert tape.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Filter by alert priority.

parameters.name: launchpad
parameters.description: Filter to one launchpad.

parameters.name: min_mc
parameters.description: Minimum market cap at alert time (USD).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Capped at 50 for BASIC/PRO; ULTRA gets the full requested value.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Incremental polling: return only alerts with `event_at` strictly newer than this ISO timestamp. Pass back `next_event_at` from the previous response to receive just what is new.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor: return only alerts with `event_at` strictly older than this ISO timestamp. Pass `next_before` from the previous response to page backwards. Takes precedence over `offset`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset pagination (RAW rows, before the gates), used when no cursor is supplied. Prefer `cursor` for stable paging over a live feed.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: PREFERRED pagination (audit F09 follow-up): the `next_cursor` from a previous page — an opaque strict (event_at, id) keyset, so paging never repeats or skips rows that share a sort value and progresses with limit=1 through runs of identical timestamps. Malformed or tampered → 400. Cannot be combined with `before=` or `offset=` (400).

200.description: `next_event_at` is the newest event_at on the page (poll cursor); `data_age_seconds` is the age of the newest alert.

tier.description: Deployer reputation tier resolved at READ time from the live deployer rollup (falls back to the snapshot when the deployer is not in the rollup).

deployer_reputation.description: v2 reputation summary at read time. Deployer Hunter v2 only (RHC_DEPLOYER_REPUTATION=v2); absent in the default v1 response.

tier.description: Deployer Hunter v2 tier: earned on organic durable runners over resolved launches (24 h or older), weighted to the last 10. The $40K milestone plays no part.

rule_version.description: Rule version that produced the tier ("v1" only during an operator rollback).

resolved_launches.description: Launches at least 24 h old whose outcome is decided.

organic_runners.description: Resolved launches that reached a $100K+ peak MC, held it, and drew independent traders without detected manipulation.

recent_rate.description: Organic runner rate over the last 10 resolved launches.

survival_1h_rate.description: Share of launches still alive 1 h after launch, over survival_sample launches.

token_outcome.description: Deployer Hunter v2 per-launch outcome; null until the token is scored. Deployer Hunter v2 only (RHC_DEPLOYER_REPUTATION=v2); absent in the default v1 response.

detected_at.description: When we first detected the token trading.

detected_mc_usd.description: Market cap at detection: the only base a since-detected multiple may use.

detection_delay_s.description: Seconds between contract creation and detection.

resolved.description: true once the launch is 24 h old and its outcome is decided.

tier_at_alert.description: Snapshot of the tier written when the alert fired.

tier_is_stale.description: true when the read-time tier differs from tier_at_alert.

mc_at_alert.description: Market cap when the alert fired (USD).

liquidity_basis.description: How liquidity_usd was derived. A uniswap-v4 row passing the $100 tradability filter is a CEILING-pass: its figure is virtual reserves clamped to the PoolManager's total holdings, not measured per-pool TVL.

tradability_filter.description: The active tradability gate, echoed: `liquidity_usd >= $100`, or `off (include_untradeable=true)`.

liquidity_note.description: Constant statement of the uniswap-v4 ceiling semantics — a v4 row passing the tradability filter is a ceiling-pass; per-row `liquidity_basis` says which rows that applies to.

next_event_at.description: Newest event_at on this page — pass as ?since= to poll forward.

next_before.description: Legacy cursor — event_at of the last row consumed (returned or gated out); pass as ?before= to page backward. Strict: skips alerts sharing that event_at. Prefer next_cursor.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next (older) page — pass as `cursor=`. null = end of feed. PREFERRED over the strict-timestamp legacy cursor, which skips same-timestamp siblings of the boundary row.

has_more.description: false only when the candidate feed is exhausted (not merely when the page is short).

scan.description: Present when a filter had to be applied after the candidate fetch (audit F09): has_more is then false only when the candidates ran out, and scan_truncated=true means the per-request scan budget ran out first — more matches MAY exist past next_cursor.

scan_truncated.description: The per-request scan budget ran out before `limit` matches — more matches MAY exist past the cursor/offset

get.summary: A Robinhood Chain developer's launches and own-token buys/sells as one timeline (PRO+)
get.description:
The REST timeline behind the `rhc:dev_activity` WS channel (2026-10-15). Events: `launch` (a token whose recorded deployer is this address), `dev_buy` / `dev_sell` (a trade of one of those tokens by this address itself, the effective trading account with ERC-4337 senders resolved). Same developer definition as the WS producer, and `event_id` equals the WS event id, so REST and WS can be joined. `attribution` `creator` = seen at launch, `pool_creator` = only the first pool's creator is known (weaker).

One event per trade leg, newest first, keyset paged over both sources with `next_cursor`. The trade scan is bounded: `coverage.scan_truncated` + `next_cursor` say where it stopped, never a false end. Window: `since` (default 30 days, at most 90). `coverage.dev_trades_complete_from` is the later of the window start and the Postgres floor; older months are in the archive and not read (`archive_required_before`).

**Not included (v1):** developer token transfers, trades from other wallets of the same person, history below `dev_trades_complete_from`. An empty timeline is not proof that nothing happened outside those bounds.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Window start; default 30 days ago, clamped to 90 days.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma list of launch, dev_buy, dev_sell (default all).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

get.summary: Is this RHC deployer getting better or worse? (BASIC+)
get.description: Streak, rolling-rate and trend shape for one Robinhood Chain deployer, so you can tell a deployer on the way up from one coasting on old hits. Field names keep the Solana `bond` wording for drop-in compatibility, but `success_metric` states what was actually counted: the **$40K graduation**, deliberately NOT the $100K tier bar — $100K is rare enough that most deployers would return an all-zero curve. Unknown wallets return 200 with `is_deployer: false` (never a 404). Tier: **BASIC**.

get.summary: Full paginated launch history for one RHC deployer (BASIC+)
get.description: Every token a Robinhood Chain deployer has launched, enriched with live MC, peak MC and liquidity. Each token carries `liquidity_basis` (`v4_virtual_ceiling` | `measured`) — uniswap-v4 liquidity_usd is a virtual-reserve ceiling, not measured per-pool TVL. Distinct from `/rhc/deployer-hunter/{address}`, which caps `recent_tokens` at 50 and is a profile read — this is the enumerable history. Unknown wallets return 200 with `is_deployer: false`. Tier: **BASIC**.

get.summary: Top launches from reputable RHC deployers (BASIC+)
get.description: The highest-peaking tokens launched by good/elite Robinhood Chain deployers in a window — "what did the deployers worth tracking actually produce". Gated on tier by design; for an unfiltered ranking use `/rhc/tokens?sort=peak_mc_usd`. Each token carries `liquidity_basis` (`v4_virtual_ceiling` | `measured`) — uniswap-v4 liquidity_usd is a virtual-reserve ceiling, not measured per-pool TVL. `truncated: true` means the window exceeded the 1,000-candidate scan, so the top-N is drawn from the most RECENT launches rather than the whole period. Tier: **BASIC**.

post.summary: Up to 50 Robinhood Chain tokens in one call (BASIC+)
post.description: Set-based batch read — three queries regardless of batch size, not a fan-out. Returns token metadata, price/MC/liquidity and deployer reputation. Deliberately does NOT compute buyer-quality (that is a per-token cohort computation; use `/rhc/tokens/batch/buyer-quality`) so a caller who only wants prices does not pay for it. Accepts `addresses` or `mints` so a ported Solana client works unchanged. **One entry is returned per REQUESTED address, in order** — unknown tokens come back as `found: false` rather than being silently omitted. Tier: **BASIC**.

status.description: Why a price field is null: no_price_yet (seen, no priced trade yet), mc_unavailable (priced, MC failed the plausibility gate or supply unknown), not_seen_yet (found:false).

liquidity_source.description: Where liquidity_usd comes from: pool_balances = uniswap-v2/v3 pool token balances; v4_virtual_ceiling = uniswap-v4 virtual reserves clamped to the PoolManager (a ceiling); bonding_curve_reserve = 2x a launchpad curve quote reserve from contract state (pons-v2, flap, hood.fun, bags); unknown_venue = no recognised primary venue.

liquidity_status.description: available = positive figure; verified_zero = explicit 0 from chain state; unavailable = liquidity_usd is null (unknown, not yet measured, unresolved quote asset, or graduated curve awaiting its pool figure). Null never means zero.

deployer.description: address + source, plus the deployer's reputation row (tier, tokens_deployed, graduated, graduation_rate, runners, runner_rate) when known.

post.summary: Early-buyer quality for up to 20 RHC tokens (BASIC+)
post.description: Scores several tokens' earliest-buyer cohorts in one call. **The cap is 20, not the Solana 50** — RHC buyer-quality is a per-token cohort computation (ordered early-buyer scan + bundle RPC + alpha/cluster joins) that cannot collapse into one set-based query, so 50 would mean ~200 round-trips behind a single request. A per-token failure degrades to an `error` entry rather than failing the batch. Scores are identical to the single-token endpoint (shared scorer). Tier: **BASIC**.

get.summary: Liquidity REMOVALS feed — the rug signal (PRO+)
get.description: Liquidity removals on Robinhood Chain from our own node's log subscription: Uniswap v2/v3 Burn and v4 ModifyLiquidity with a negative delta, for tracked pools. **By default removals only** — a request without `action` returns exactly what it always did, so an empty default page means 'no removals seen', never 'no liquidity activity'. Amounts are RAW on-chain integers as strings; token0/token1 say which side is which and token_amount_raw/quote_amount_raw pre-resolve the token side. v4 rows carry liquidity only (the pool manager emits no token amounts). provider_is_token_deployer is the classic rug tell. Cursor via next_before (same opaque (block_time,id) keyset as /rhc/trades). Data since 2026-08-05. **Adds, pool creations and depth fields (2026-09-23):** `action=add|pool_created|all` opts into liquidity adds (v2/v3 Mint, v4 positive ModifyLiquidity; kept 7 days) and live pool creations (kept 30 days like removals), persisted since the WS Phase 3 producer — earlier windows hold removals only. Every row also carries `tick_lower`, `tick_upper`, `liquidity_delta`, `in_range`, `active_liquidity_delta`, `active_share` (v3/v4, a share of liquidity at the current price, not of TVL), `share_of_reserves` (v2) and `material` (a removal of at least 25 % of reserves / active liquidity), null where the pool state was unknown and on older rows. `provider` is the log's sender/owner — usually the router or position manager on v3/v4, not the beneficial owner. The same events are pushed live on WS channel `rhc:lp_events` (ULTRA+). Tier: **PRO+**.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page (1-200, default 50).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Filter to one token address.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.description: Pool address (v2/v3) or bytes32 poolId (v4).

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Filter to one liquidity provider (the wallet that pulled).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Which liquidity actions to return (2026-09-23). Default `remove` = the historical removals-only feed, unchanged. `add` (kept 7 days), `pool_created` or `all` opt into the rows persisted since the WS Phase 3 producer.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from next_before.

get.summary: Token locks & vesting feed — newest lock contracts across all tokens (PRO+)
get.description: Newest token lock / vesting contracts CREATED on Robinhood Chain, newest first: who just locked tokens, of what, how much, until when. Decoded from the locker contracts' own events on our node (services/rhc-lock-tracker, chain-wide topic0 probe with no address filter — a new deployment of a known locker shape is caught on first sight): PinkLock-compatible, HoodLock (+ vesting), Team Finance-compatible (+ LP NFT), Titan Locker (token / LP / position), UNCX v2/v3-compatible LP lockers, Sablier Lockup v4 (linear / tranched / dynamic). Every row carries the on-chain schedule (start / cliff / end, cliff amount, tranches) and a live derived view: `locked_*` (still locked right now), `unlocked_*`, `next_unlock` (cliff | final | tranche), `status`; `sender` is the depositor/creator (compare with the token's deployer for a dev lock), `recipient` the beneficiary when different; `cancelable` / `cancelable_by_sender` from Sablier's flag (null where the family does not say). Amounts are RAW base units as strings; ui/usd/pct are null when decimals/price are unknown. **Create-only tape**: withdrawals / cancels are NOT tracked (no RHC locker publishes a verified release event shape) — `withdrawn` is null (unknown), never 0, and the `coverage` block says `withdrawals_tracked: false`. LP locks (subject=lp — RHC launchpads auto-lock LP on every launch) are stored but excluded unless `subject=lp|all`, carry pair/liquidity units and never claim usd/pct. Cursor: `cursor=` (`pagination.next_cursor`, strict (created_at, id) — preferred), `since=` (`pagination.next_since`) / legacy `before=`. The status / min_usd / min_pct_of_supply post-filters are served by a bounded scan (`pagination.scan`). Pushed live as `rhc:token_lock` on WS channel `rhc:token_locks`. Tier: **PRO+**.

get.summary: Smart-money wallet ranking on Robinhood Chain (PRO+)
get.description:
Robinhood Chain wallets ranked by observed ETH flow and win-rate heuristics. `net_eth` is ETH from sales minus ETH spent on buys, not cost-basis profit or the value of tokens still held. `win_rate` is a rollup heuristic over traded tokens, not the FIFO wallet PnL win rate. `likely_bot` identifies likely atomic-arbitrage and market-maker fleets. `memecoin_share` is the launchpad-token trade share. Derived from our node, refreshed every 15 min.

**Sell-only wallet filter:** `zero_cost_share` is the fraction of a wallet's gross sale ETH from tokens with no observed buy. This can happen for transferred or allocated tokens; it does not by itself prove missing ingestion or trading profit. Wallets with `zero_cost_share` at or above 0.5 are excluded by default. Pass `include_zero_cost_dumps=true` to see them and read `zero_cost_share` on every row. A high `net_eth` is observed flow, not verified profitability. Tier: **PRO+**.

get.description:
Any Robinhood Chain wallet's 90-day trading profile: FIFO cost-basis PnL, per-token breakdown, recent trades, and a reputation block (tracked KOL, known deployer + tier, alpha-ranked, dump-cluster membership, early-buyer count).

**Denomination is ETH**, matching the rest of the RHC tree (`eth_amount`, `net_eth`) — not USD. A USD cost basis would silently mix in the tokenized-stock quote assets some flap bonding curves price in.

**Sourced from `trader_eoa` — the effective trading account, never the swap-log `trader`**, which is the router address on any aggregated swap.

`stats.analyzed_trades + stats.unattributed_trades + stats.unsized_trades === stats.total_trades` always holds — no trade silently vanishes from the accounting. The two exclusions mean different things: **`unattributed_trades`** is swaps with no token side at all (token↔token exotic pools, unclassified pools) and is routine, often large for MM bots; **`unsized_trades`** is a token-side trade whose quantity could not be reconstructed from `rhc_trades`' raw uint256 leg amounts, which is the actual quality signal and should be ~0.

**Attribution floor:** analysis starts at `notes.attribution_complete_from` (2026-07-18) rather than the full 90 days — `trader_eoa` was written for under half of earlier trades, and a partial view produces positions the wallet no longer holds.

A wallet exceeding the 50,000-trade analysis cap returns `stats.partial: true`. Heavy wallets that blow the query budget return the reputation block with `stats_unavailable: true` rather than a 500. Responses are cached 60s per address. Tier: **PRO+**.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: EVM wallet address (0x, 40 hex). Case-insensitive; echoed lowercase.

200.description: OK. `stats` is null only when the wallet is known solely through a reputation table (e.g. a deployer that has never traded).

analyzed_trades.description: Trades that entered the FIFO computation.

unattributed_trades.description: Swaps with no token side or direction — token↔token exotic pools and pools our resolver has not classified. Routine, and a large share for MM bots (47% on one 512k-trade fleet wallet). NOT a data-quality signal.

unsized_trades.description: Token-side trades whose QUANTITY could not be reconstructed — excluded from PnL entirely. This IS the quality signal and should be ~0 (measured 0 across a 512k-trade wallet).

unrealized_pnl_eth.description: Mark-to-market on FIFO-open positions using rhc_token_prices.last_price_native. Unpriced positions contribute 0. **FIFO figure, not a holding**: it includes lots transferred out since the buy. For PnL on what is actually held use `holdings.unrealized_known_eth`.

held_value_eth.description: FIFO-unmatched DEX buys x current price. **Not an on-chain balance**: a token sent out by transfer still counts here. The proven current value is `holdings.verified_value_eth`.

open_positions.description: FIFO-open positions (unmatched DEX buys). How many are actually still held is in `holdings`.

partial.description: Present only when the 50,000-trade cap was hit.

deployer_runner_rate.description: v1 runner rate (runners / tokens_deployed of the v1 rollup), also served under RHC_DEPLOYER_REPUTATION=v2. Deprecated (Deployer Hunter v1 metric): kept for compatibility with its v1 meaning and value (computed by the v1 rollup, refreshed every 5 minutes), also under Deployer Hunter v2; it does not set the v2 tier. Use organic_runners / resolved_launches / lifetime_rate / recent_rate.

deployer_organic_runner_rate.description: Organic durable runners / resolved launches. Additive; absent unless RHC_DEPLOYER_REPUTATION=v2.

deployer_resolved_launches.description: Resolved launches behind deployer_organic_runner_rate. Additive; absent unless RHC_DEPLOYER_REPUTATION=v2.

is_dumper.description: ≥5 dump cohorts AND 0 runner cohorts, rolling 42d. Rebuilt daily — up to ~48h stale. Absence means NOT OBSERVED, not verified clean.

early_buyer_tokens.description: Tokens where this wallet was in the first-20 buyer cohort.

still_holding.description: FIFO meaning: an unmatched DEX buy exists. NOT an on-chain balance; see holding_status.

holding_status.description: On-chain status of a FIFO-open token; null when the token is FIFO-closed.

holdings.description: On-chain verification of every FIFO-open position: balanceOf + decimals read from our own Robinhood Chain node in one Multicall3 batch (cached 30 s). `complete: false` means at least one position is BALANCE_UNVERIFIED (node unreachable, call reverted, non-standard token, decimals mismatch) and contributes NO value.

verified_value_eth.description: PROVEN balances x current price: the current value of the tokens this wallet bought on a DEX and still holds. Unverified and unpriced positions contribute nothing.

cost_basis_held_eth.description: Cost basis of the FIFO-known portion still in the wallet.

unrealized_known_eth.description: Unrealized PnL on the portion whose cost basis is known AND still held. External inflows never add trading profit.

cost_basis_not_held_eth.description: Cost basis of FIFO lots no longer in the wallet (transferred out or disposed outside indexed swaps). Outcome unknown: neither realized nor unrealized.

stats_unavailable.description: Present when the trade aggregation was skipped on a timeout. Absence of stats is then UNPROVEN — do not read it as an inactive wallet.

404.description: No recorded Robinhood Chain activity for this address as a trading account (`trader_eoa`). The body carries `address_type` (`eoa` / `eoa_7702` / `contract` / `unknown`, from eth_getCode); for a contract also `contract_trader_swaps_last_hour` (swaps where it is the swap-log trader; null = not measured) and a `note`. A contract cannot sign transactions, so its own swaps are never attributed to a wallet here; identities are not merged.

Evidence of a funding connection — not proof of common ownership. Internal (contract → wallet) ETH transfers are not observed. Forward-looking coverage from monitoring start; no historical backfill.

An empty `shared_funders` with status ok means no shared funder was OBSERVED within coverage — never that wallets are independent.

Absent when the direct read fails — the shared-funder answer above still stands. `observed: false` carries `coverage`, `coverage_explanation`, `observation_started_at` and `note` (no funding observed within coverage is not evidence the wallet was never funded). `observed: true` adds the coverage fields, `asset_scope`, `native_funding`, `token_funding`, `sources[]` and `source_count` (PRO); cross-wallet `relationships` counts are ULTRA+ and removed below ULTRA.

get.summary: Observed trading profit on Robinhood Chain (PRO+)
get.description:
Trading profit for one RHC wallet over the observed 90-day window. Sales are matched to the oldest observed buys (FIFO), the same method as Solana, with ETH units. Sales without an observed purchase cost are excluded from profit. `summary.realized_eth` covers matched sales. `summary.unrealized_eth` and `open_positions` are based on recorded DEX buys not matched by recorded DEX sales, marked to current price; **they are not verified current holdings**. For on-chain balances and profit on the known-cost portion still held, use `/rhc/wallet/{address}/positions` and its `summary.holdings`.

`notes.cost_basis_observable_from` marks the beginning of usable purchase history. The wallet attribution floor is 2026-07-18 (`notes.attribution_complete_from`); earlier trades cannot reliably be linked to a wallet. `notes.partial` also flags the 50,000-trade analysis cap. Cached 120s per address. Tier: **PRO+**.

completeness.description: Realized-PnL completeness. incomplete when at least one sell in the response has proceeds that went to another wallet (price_status proceeds_unattributed, migration 508): realized PnL and ROI then cover the known basis only, and the basis those sells consumed is reported as unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol, never as 0 proceeds or a loss. This is realized-PnL completeness. It is NOT `coverage.completeness` (source-coverage verification: verified / not_verified / ...), which says whether the trade capture for this subject is proven complete.

incomplete_reasons.description: Empty when complete. /wallet/{address} emits only proceeds_unattributed; /tokens/{mint}/top-traders emits proceeds_unattributed and, since migration 548 (2026-11-11), unknown_consideration; unknown_consideration and missing_cost_basis (sales without an observed purchase) are shared with the FIFO routes (/pnl, /positions).

realized_eth.description: Profit on sales matched to observed earlier buys only.

unrealized_eth.description: Price change on trade-derived open positions; current on-chain balances are not checked by this route.

total_pnl_eth.description: Realized plus trade-derived unrealized. Not complete wallet profit when purchase cost or holdings are unobserved.

profit_factor.description: Gross wins / gross losses. null when there are no losses (undefined math), 0 when there are no wins.

pnl_curve.description: Sparse daily UTC buckets of REALIZED PnL. `cumulative_pnl` is the running sum of `day_pnl`; days with no realized events are omitted.

hold_minutes.description: Token-weighted across matched FIFO lots — correct for re-entered tokens.

result.description: unknown = the outcome has no proven cost basis (a sale beyond the observed buys, missing_cost_basis) or an unknown consideration: no ROI (roi_pct null), not counted in wins, losses or win_rate.

open_positions.description: Recorded DEX buys not matched by recorded DEX sales, marked to current price. Not proof of an on-chain balance. Each entry carries `liquidity_basis` (`v4_virtual_ceiling` | `measured`); uniswap-v4 liquidity_usd is a virtual-reserve ceiling, not measured per-pool TVL.

data_through.description: Newest trade this answer was computed from — the response's vintage. Equals `stats.last_seen` on /rhc/wallet/{address} when both ran over the same data. Use this, not a trade count, to tell whether two responses are comparable: the count saturates at the analysis cap.

trades_unattributed.description: No token side / direction (exotic or unresolved pool). Routine.

get.description:
Recorded DEX buys not matched by recorded DEX sales, with a current on-chain balance check for each token. This is the same trade-position calculation as `/pnl`, without its curve and closed positions. A transfer into the wallet can create a balance with no recorded purchase cost; a transfer out can leave a trade position open even when the balance is zero. Read `holding_status` and `current_onchain_balance` to know what is held now. `summary.holdings.verified_value_eth` counts proven, priced balances; `summary.holdings.unrealized_known_eth` counts value change only on the known-cost portion still held.

The older `token_amount`, `current_value_eth`, `unrealized_eth` and top-level summary totals remain trade-derived for compatibility. `BALANCE_UNVERIFIED` means no balance or value is assumed. Analysis starts at `notes.attribution_complete_from` (2026-07-18) if the 90-day window reaches earlier trades. `unpriced_positions` counts positions omitted from trade-derived value totals. Tier: **PRO+**.

200.description: OK. Sorted by current value, then cost basis.

total_unrealized_eth.description: Against the cost basis of the priced subset only.

holdings.description: On-chain verification of every FIFO-open position: balanceOf + decimals read from our own Robinhood Chain node in one Multicall3 batch (cached 30 s). `complete: false` means at least one position is BALANCE_UNVERIFIED (node unreachable, call reverted, non-standard token, decimals mismatch) and contributes NO value.

verified_value_eth.description: PROVEN balances x current price: the current value of the tokens this wallet bought on a DEX and still holds. Unverified and unpriced positions contribute nothing.

cost_basis_held_eth.description: Cost basis of the FIFO-known portion still in the wallet.

unrealized_known_eth.description: Unrealized PnL on the portion whose cost basis is known AND still held. External inflows never add trading profit.

cost_basis_not_held_eth.description: Cost basis of FIFO lots no longer in the wallet (transferred out or disposed outside indexed swaps). Outcome unknown: neither realized nor unrealized.

liquidity_basis.description: How liquidity_usd was derived. uniswap-v4 figures are virtual reserves clamped to the PoolManager's total holdings — a provable ceiling, not measured per-pool TVL.

realized_so_far_eth.description: Partial exits already taken on this token.

fifo_unmatched_amount.description: DEX buys not matched by a DEX sell (same as token_amount). A trading position, not a balance.

current_onchain_balance.description: balanceOf(wallet) / 10^decimals from our node. null = not proven (BALANCE_UNVERIFIED).

held_known_amount.description: min(balance, FIFO): the held part whose cost basis is known.

current_holding_value_eth.description: current_onchain_balance x current price. 0 when transferred out; null when unverified or unpriced.

unrealized_known_eth.description: Unrealized on the known-cost, still-held portion only.

cost_basis_not_held_eth.description: Cost basis of the FIFO portion no longer in the wallet. Outcome unknown.

`token_amount` is reconstructed from raw uint256 leg amounts and is **null when it cannot be** — never zero, and never a guess. Tier: **PRO+**.

**Where the rows come from** (*added 2026-08-29*): closed months older than the newest three move from Postgres to a Parquet archive; pages are split at `history.postgres_from` (ISO) — rows at/after it from Postgres, older rows from the archive reader, same ordering and `before` cursor. `history.archive_used`, `archive_months`, `archive_available` (`null` = not configured) and `truncated` (older history requested but the archive did not answer — retry rather than treating `has_more:false` as the end) mirror `/tokens/{mint}/trades`. Header `X-Read-Source`: `core`, `core+archive` or `archive`.

post.description:
Mirror chosen Robinhood Chain wallets to a webhook or the `rhc:copytrade:signals` WebSocket channel. Any valid 0x source wallet fires, KOL or not (`source_admission: any_wallet`, production since 2026-10-04; KOL membership is enrichment only and copy-trade sources do not use Wallet Tracker quota); `operational_state` says whether the rule can fire right now. A source trade must be at most 5 s old by chain time. Addresses are **lowercased on write** — the evaluator matches the lowercased event address, so a checksummed rule would never fire. Amounts are ETH. Idempotency is `(subscription_id, tx_hash)`, so a replayed event can never double-fire.

**No `min_mc_usd`/`max_mc_usd`**: the RHC trade event carries no market cap, so an MC band could only be a per-event database lookup on a ~3.3M trades/day chain or a filter that silently never matches. Returns `webhook_secret` once, never again.

get.description: List every Robinhood Chain market-cap price alert you own, active and paused, newest first. Each alert carries its token, the baseline market cap captured at creation, the `drop_pct` / `recovery_pct` thresholds, its current `status` (watching, then dipped, then recovered), the dip low, delivery config and expiry. Alerts are evaluated as trades land (event-driven off the chain trade feed, a few seconds of latency), with periodic table polls as a safety net. The quota counts active alerts only and is separate from Solana: PRO 5, ULTRA 50, BUSINESS 150.

post.description:
Market-cap drop alert with an optional recovery leg, baselined against the token's market cap **at creation**. One-shot state machine: `watching → dipped → recovered`; `dip_low` ratchets down while dipped; terminal on the dip when no `recovery_pct` is set.

⚠️ **Latency differs from the Solana price alerts.** Solana alerts are evaluated inside a live in-memory price loop every 250 ms. RHC alerts are **event-driven**: each trade on the chain's trade feed (`rhc:dex_trade`) is checked against the alerted token set, with price-table polls (every 5 s while the feed is degraded or a trade carried no market cap, 60 s otherwise) and a trade-tape replay after a feed outage as safety nets. Latency is a few seconds (the chain trade flush is about 2 s), not sub-second. Every create response carries an `evaluation` block restating this. Do not size a strategy on the Solana figure. `token_address`, `drop_pct` and `recovery_pct` are immutable after creation.

recovery_pct.description: Omit for a dip-only, terminal alert

get.description: List every Robinhood Chain KOL coordination rule you own, active and paused, newest first. A rule fires when at least `min_kols` tracked KOLs buy the same token within `window_minutes` and the coordination score reaches `min_score`, optionally bounded by a market-cap range; `cooldown_min` and `score_jump_break` decide when the same token may fire again. The quota counts every rule, paused ones included, and is separate from Solana: PRO 5, ULTRA 20, BUSINESS 100.

post.description:
Fires when `min_kols` distinct tracked KOLs buy the same Robinhood Chain token inside `window_minutes` and the cluster scores at least `min_score`. `cooldown_min` suppresses repeats per (rule, token); `score_jump_break` is an **early exit from that cooldown** when the score climbs by at least that many points (the re-fire is flagged `is_rearm`). An unknown market cap is **dropped** by the MC band, never treated as inside it.

**Scoring** uses the same v1 scorer as the Solana coordination alerts, so the number is comparable — with two differences recorded per-signal in `score_inputs`: `quality` is real (from the RHC KOL win-rate matview) while `earliness` is **defaulted**, because RHC has no early-entry measure. `density` is 1.0 by construction inside a rule's own window, so live scores start at 30.

A subscription fires when a tracked KOL is the first to buy a token, filtered by KOL, minimum first-buy size in ETH, KOL win rate, trading strategy and market-cap range, and delivers per rule to a webhook, the WebSocket or both. ULTRA and BUSINESS only; the unfiltered broadcast is on WS channel `rhc:kol:first_touches` for PRO+. The quota counts every subscription, paused ones included, and is separate from Solana: ULTRA 10, BUSINESS 50.

post.description:
Push the moment a token receives its **first** buy from a tracked KOL — the earliest signal available. A second KOL buying the same token produces nothing; dedup is structural (one first-touch row per token, ever).

**Filters are `.strict()`** — an unknown key is a 400, not a silently ignored filter. ⚠️ There is deliberately **no `min_scout_tier` / `min_n_touches`** as on Solana: RHC has no scout scoring, and a filter that silently matched nothing would be worse than its absence. `min_kol_winrate` and `strategy` are the quality gates instead. An unknown market cap is dropped by the MC band, never passed.

Two consequences: a wallet added today reports its **full history** in the period rather than only what happens after you subscribe, and these numbers agree with `/rhc/wallet/{address}` by construction. Tier: **PRO+**.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: PREFERRED pagination (audit F09 follow-up): the `next_cursor` from a previous page — an opaque strict (traded_at, id) keyset, so paging never repeats or skips rows that share a timestamp and progresses with limit=1 through runs of identical timestamps. Malformed or tampered → 400. Cannot be combined with `before=` (400); `before=` stays supported as the legacy bound.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next (older) page — pass as `cursor=`. PREFERRED over next_before, which is a strict timestamp bound that skips same-timestamp siblings of the boundary row.

next_since.description: Poll cursor: traded_at of the newest row on this page (or the `since` you sent when the page is empty). Pass as `since=` to fetch only newer rows; if count === limit page down with before= until you pass your previous since.

Under migration 526 (winrate_method present): the FIFO 7-day unknown realizations next to closed_positions_known_7d; the PnL counter moves to pnl_unknown_realizations_7d.

get.description: The deployer's reputation **exactly as it stood on `date`** (default today, UTC) — the latest write-on-change snapshot at or before that date, so a backtest sees only what was knowable then. Because snapshots are only written when state changes, `snapshot.snapshot_date` can be earlier than `requested_date`; both are returned and `carried: true` marks that case. If no snapshot exists at or before `date` the response is `as_of: false, snapshot: null` — nothing is synthesized. `first_snapshot_date` says when tracking began. Snapshots exist from 2026-04-07. Untracked wallets return `is_deployer: false`. PRO+.
