get.summary: Deployer creator-fee rewards — collected vs attributed
get.description: pump.fun **creator-fee rewards** for a wallet, answered two ways that are never merged. **`collected`** = what actually reached the wallet: `direct_claims` (collect_creator_fee — these rows carry no mint; history since 2026-08-17 is retained, archive policy pending), `social_claims` (social-handle PDA claims paid to the wallet) and `share_payouts` (distribute_creator_fees payouts naming the wallet as a shareholder, on any token — `on_own_tokens` isolates the ones it deployed). **`attributed`** = every distribute_creator_fees payout on the tokens the wallet **deployed**, whoever received it, split `to_self` / `to_others` with `redirected_pct`. A deployer whose attributed total dwarfs its collected total is redirecting fees (launch tool, KOL, social handle) — that gap is the signal. Each money block carries `sol`, `usdc` and `usd` (quotes are summed separately; `usd` is null when a SOL amount exists and no SOL price is available, never a silent zero). `top_tokens` / `top_recipients` (≤10 each) show where the attributed fees went, with social PDAs labelled. Works for non-deployers too (`is_deployer: false`, attributed empty). Shareholder payouts and social claims since 2026-08-17. Tokens on the default config (100% to the creator) pay via direct claims, so `attributed` only covers tokens whose fees were ever split. PRO+.

tokens_in_scope.description: tokens attributed to the wallet in our token table — the universe `attributed` is computed over; not the profile's total_tokens_deployed

redirected_pct.description: share of attributed fees that went to wallets other than the deployer (0–100)

get.summary: Deployer activity timeline (launches, dev buys/sells/transfers, creator transfers, fees, funding)
get.description: One newest-first timeline of what a deployer wallet did, from data MadeOnSol already holds. **The window applies to each event's own time** (`window.applies_to: event_time`): a sell yesterday of a token launched months ago is inside a 30-day window. Event types: `launch` (every launchpad we index; `fee_payer_is_creator` / `external_fee_payer` say whether the creator paid the create fee, null when unknown; `dev_buy_sol` / `dev_buy_tokens` / `dev_buy_supply_pct` from the create transaction when recorded), `dev_buy` / `dev_sell` (the deployer's own classified trades from the stored trade tape plus persisted realtime dev events where applicable; realtime rows can include activity below the ordinary trade persistence floor), `dev_token_transfer_out` / `dev_token_transfer_in` (persisted developer transfers of the attributed token; one public aggregate per transaction/mint/direction/actor, with raw amount/counterparty fields; recovered gap rows are REST history only and were never delivered live), `creator_transferred` (pump.fun creator rights moved to or from this wallet: the raw `from` / `to` of the event, `direction`, `initiated_by` creator | platform_admin | other_signer | unknown), `fee_claim` (creator-fee claims paid to the wallet), `funding_in` (one event per funder, timed by the latest transfer, `first_at` = first transfer; recorded only while the wallet is in the funding tracked set) and `capital_out` (one event per recipient address, timed by the latest transfer; recorded only when the wallet is a tracked high-signal source). Addresses in events are raw facts of the concrete event, not identity claims. Every event carries `time_basis` (chain | ingest | chain_or_ingest). `coverage.families.<family>` states each source, retention, scope, `truncated`, `complete`, `complete_from` and `archive_required_before`. **History is served from the online (Postgres) store; older trade months live only in the Parquet archive.** Archive reads for `dev_trades` are being rolled out for ULTRA and BUSINESS (PRO's 30-day window never reaches the archive). While they are off, a window that crosses that boundary is never reported as complete: `dev_trades` answers `complete: false`, `complete_from` = the earliest instant the online store covers completely, `archive_required_before` = the instant before which events exist only in the archive, and `coverage.status` is `partial`. If the boundary cannot be read, the family is `complete: false` with `boundary_known: false`. Fixed-retention families also carry `retention_boundary`: when the dev-event source is enabled, `dev_transfers` (SPL / Token-2022 transfers of the deployer's own token from the legacy watch + broad attributed-creator source) is held 30 days online, so a window starting before `retention_boundary` answers `complete: false` with `complete_from` = `retention_boundary` and `coverage.status: partial` (those rows are pruned, not archived). A wallet MadeOnSol has never attributed a launch to cannot have dev trades: `dev_trades` is then not queried and says `skipped_reason: no_attributed_launch`. `plan.history` separates the requested window (`requested`, `effective` after the tier clamp), the online coverage (`online`, served) and the archive-only range (`archive_only`, null when the window does not reach it). Without archive reads `archive_only` says `served: false`, `reason: archive_reads_not_enabled`. With archive reads, `coverage.families.dev_trades.archive` reports the read (`read` ok | not_needed | failed, `served`, `reason`, `missing_months`, `months_read`) and `archive_only.served` is true only when the archive answered for the whole range; `dev_trades` is then `complete: true` with `archive_required_before: null`. When an archive month is missing, `complete_from` / `archive_required_before` move to the end of the newest missing month (`reason: archive_months_missing`). If the archive is unavailable or times out, the online part is returned with `complete: false` and `reason` archive_unavailable | archive_timeout | archive_contract_mismatch | archive_ledger_unavailable, never an error and never a false complete. **An empty family is not evidence that nothing happened.** Paginate with `cursor` (opaque, ordered by (at, id), never skips equal timestamps). Server-side hard caps by plan (`plan` echoes them): PRO a 30-day window / 100 per page, ULTRA a 365-day window / 100 per page, BUSINESS an unbounded window / 500 per page; a larger `limit` is clamped (`pagination.limit_capped`) and an earlier `since` is clamped to the plan window. The ULTRA and BUSINESS windows normally reach past the online trade boundary, so their `dev_trades` coverage is usually partial (see above). ULTRA and BUSINESS responses carry an `identity` block, which currently answers `status: not_available` (identity stitching is not released; no linked wallets are reported, which says nothing about whether the wallet operates alone). PRO responses never carry an identity block or a fee-payer address. LIVE in production for PRO+. The capability flag remains a rollback guard; if an operator disables the feature the route answers 503 `feature_disabled` rather than returning a false empty timeline.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Events per page. Clamped to the plan's hard cap: 100 (PRO, ULTRA) or 500 (BUSINESS).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous page. A cursor older than the effective window returns 400.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Requested window start (ISO 8601). Clamped to the plan window, never widened; in the future → 400. Default: the plan window.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma list of event types: launch, dev_buy, dev_sell, dev_token_transfer_out, dev_token_transfer_in, creator_transferred, fee_claim, funding_in, capital_out.

archive_only.description: Range held only in the Parquet archive. null when the window does not reach it. served:true only when the archive answered for the whole range (reason null); otherwise served:false with the reason (missing_months when month-shaped).

missing_months.description: YYYY-MM months of the range that are not served.

actor_wallet.description: Realtime dev-event actor; direct developer or, for ULTRA+ identity projection, a proven linked wallet.

token_amount_raw.description: Exact base-unit amount for realtime dev events.

counterparty.description: Raw transfer counterparty; never an identity claim.

feed.description: Timeline source/projection marker for dev events.

counterparty_count.description: Developer token transfers (dev-event source only): one event per (transaction, mint, direction, actor); `counterparty` is the largest counterparty, this is how many counterparties the aggregate has. Null on rows stored before 2026-10-06.

recovered.description: Developer token transfers (dev-event source only): present and true when the event was recovered into stored history after a delivery gap (it was never delivered live on WS or webhook). `time_basis` says which clock `at` uses: re-derived from a confirmed block = chain block time (`time_basis: chain`); replayed from the producer spool = the original receive time (`time_basis: ingest`).

recovered_at.description: With `recovered: true`: when the recovery stored the event (not the event's time).

late_classified.description: Developer token transfers (dev-event source only): present and true when the event was received live but classified after a short creator lookup (a token minutes or seconds old). `at` stays the receive time.

retention_boundary.description: Fixed-retention families only (dev_transfers: 30 days online). Before this instant the rows were pruned; a window starting earlier is complete: false.

archive.description: dev_trades only, only while archive reads are enabled and the window reaches below the online boundary.

launchpads.description: launches only (additive, 2026-10-18): per proven launchpad (pumpfun, raydium_launchlab, meteora_dbc incl. Bags), whether this window is fully held. complete_from = the later of the window start and the launchpad boundary measured on the online store (pump.fun and LaunchLab unbonded launches from 2026-07-03T05:00Z, before it bonded launches only; Meteora DBC from 2026-10-03T16:32:57Z, nothing before). The family-level complete / complete_from follow the STRICTEST supported boundary (complete only when the window starts at or after it; complete_from = the later of the window start and it; an unbounded window is never complete), so coverage.status is partial while any supported launchpad misses part of the window. A boundary describes known coverage, not proof that every transaction arrived: gaps inside the covered period are not measured.

launchpads_not_indexed.description: launches only: launchpads that are NOT supported (recognized, no proven create attribution: moonit, boop, heaven); their launches never appear and they do not affect complete.

identity.description: ULTRA and BUSINESS only; absent on PRO. Currently always `status: not_available` with `reason: identity_stitching_not_released` (identity stitching is not released). When released, the block is read from MadeOnSol's offline identity graph (one hop: the wallet's identity, with evidence and confidence) and answers `not_available` with another `reason` whenever that graph is not current or fails a consistency check (`builder_stale`: the graph is older than `builder.stale_after_seconds`; old links are never served as current). `not_available` never means the wallet operates alone.

400.description: Invalid wallet, limit below 1, unknown event type, malformed cursor, a cursor outside the effective window, or a malformed / future `since`

503.description: `code: feature_disabled` when the production capability is deliberately disabled/rolled back; no data keys and never a false empty result.

get.description:
Browse tokens by market-cap band, liquidity floor, recent-activity window, primary DEX, authority/safety flags, computed 1h volume, MEV-share ceiling, and MC change. Momentum sorts surface movers (`mc_change_5m_desc`, `mc_change_1h_desc`, `volume_1h_desc`) and a composite `trending` board. Complements `/token/{mint}` (single lookup), `/tokens/almost-bonded` (pre-bond pump.fun), and the KOL-scoped `/kol/tokens/{hot,trending}`.

**Default `min_liq` is 2000 USD** to filter the long tail of phantom-MC tokens from low-liquidity pools. Pass `min_liq=0` to opt out.

**Default `max_mc` is 100,000,000,000 USD ($100B)** — a sanity ceiling that drops phantom market caps (a genuine ~1e12 token supply trading near $1, or a thin-pool price blow-up). No real tracked memecoin approaches it. Pass a higher explicit `max_mc` to opt out.

**Momentum sorts + filters are DB-native** (via the `token_prices_trending` view): `min_volume_1h_usd`, `max_mev_share_pct`, `min_liq_mc_ratio`, `max_liq_mc_ratio`, `mc_change_1h_min_pct`, `mc_change_1h_max_pct` and the momentum sorts paginate correctly with no over-fetch. The `trending` sort = recent-volume × positive-momentum composite, recency-bounded to the last 1h, and echoes `filters.trending_version: "v1"`.

**Only `deployer_tier` and `launchpad`** remain post-filters (joined from `deployer_tokens`, not the view). They are served by a bounded SCAN: candidates are walked in pages until `limit` matches, the candidates run out, or the scan budget is spent. `has_more:false` only when the candidates ran out; `pagination.scan_truncated:true` = the budget ran out first and more matches MAY exist — continue with `offset = pagination.next_offset` (a RAW candidate offset, not a match count). Offset pages walk a LIVE order (`pagination.order_is_live: true`): MC and activity move between calls, so rows can shift across pages — treat the screener as a ranking, not a ledger.

**LP burn (2026-09-21):** `lp_burned` / `lp_burn_status` come from LP-custody evidence only (`lp_burnt_pct`). No Solana writer populates it yet, so `lp_burn_status` is `unknown` and `lp_burned` null for every token, and `lp_burned=true|false` currently matches nothing. `lp_burned` is DEPRECATED: `true` = verified burned/locked, `false` = verified NOT burned, and a token with unknown LP custody matches neither (false never turns unknown into "unburned"); a request that sends it gets a `deprecations` entry. The old `lp_burned` flag was the token-SUPPLY burn — filter that with `supply_burn` and read it as `token_supply_burn_detected`.

get.description:
Every captured trade for one token, newest first — the backfill complement to the live firehose (seed history, then keep current via the stream). Per trade: tx_signature, wallet_address, action, sol_amount, token_amount, price_sol/price_usd, market_price_sol/market_price_usd, early_buyer_rank, slot, block_time.

**Two different prices, on purpose.** `price_sol` is *this trade's executed price* — `sol_amount / token_amount`, so it reconciles exactly with the amounts on the same row and with the PnL endpoints. `sol_amount` is the wallet's net SOL movement, so that price is the trader's all-in effective rate: it includes the swap fee and any account rent paid in the same transaction, and it is not the pool mid. `market_price_sol` is our market-cap tracker's canonical pool price sampled near that trade's slot — one value per token per update, so every trade in the same slot shares it. Use `price_sol` for cost basis, fills and PnL; use `market_price_sol` when you want a per-token price series independent of trade size and direction.

**Exact amounts** (`amounts`, not yet enabled — appears on every row once exact amounts are switched on): `sol_amount` and `token_amount` keep their meaning (gross SOL movement incl. fee/rent; 6-decimal rounded UI amount). `amounts` adds the exact base-unit values as strings — see the TradeRawAmounts schema. Rows stored before exact amounts existed report `raw_known: false` with every field null (unknown, never 0).

*Changed 2026-08-16*: `price_sol`/`price_usd` previously carried the canonical value, which disagreed with the row's own amounts by a 7.9% median (and far more on fast-moving mints, where one slot can span a 60% price swing). The canonical number did not disappear — it moved to `market_price_*`.

**Coverage honesty**: capture starts 2026-04-12 and is pump.fun-pipeline scoped — the `coverage` response object carries both markers. **Size floor**: Trades stored from 2026-10-22T19:53:00.000Z have no size floor. Before 2026-10-22T19:53:00.000Z (legacy policy) buys under 0.05 SOL (under $3.50 when paid in USDC/USDT) were not stored; sells that receive SOL were kept at any size. (`coverage.size_floor`). Default window is full history. PRO+.

**Where the rows come from** (*added 2026-08-29*): closed months older than the newest three move from Postgres to a Parquet archive; pages are split at `history.postgres_from` (Unix seconds) — rows at/after it are served from Postgres, older rows from the archive reader — with the same ordering and cursor. `history.archive_used` says whether this page touched the archive (`archive_months` lists which), `history.archive_available` whether the archive could be reached (`null` = not configured), and `history.truncated: true` means older history was requested but the archive did not answer — retry later rather than treating `has_more:false` as the end of the tape. Response header `X-Read-Source`: `core`, `core+archive` or `archive`.

An unproven amount is never served as 0 (since 2026-10-28).

PRO gets all timeframes with the last 30 days of history measured from now (`history_floor`): a window entirely older returns 200 with zero candles and `history_outside_plan: true`, a partly older one is clamped (`history_clamped: true`). ULTRA (and BUSINESS) adds net-flow/liquidity fields and full retained history. This tier split applies to Solana candles only; RHC candles are full-history on PRO+. Candles are read newest-first in grid-aligned database windows that start small and grow while reads are fast; each request has a time budget of about five seconds. When the time budget runs out (typically a dense token over closed months on cold storage) the default answer is 503 `read_budget_exhausted` with `covered_from` and Retry-After; with `partial=allow` the newest complete candles read so far are returned with `truncated: true` and `covered_from` (continue with `to=covered_from`). Never a partial candle.

parameters.description: Solana token mint address

parameters.name: tf
parameters.description: Candle timeframe. Also accepted as `timeframe`, `interval` or `resolution`; `tf` wins, then in that order. An unknown value is a 400, never the default.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Same as `tf`; read only when `tf` is absent.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Same as `tf`, also in the charting minute spelling `1`, `5`, `15`, `60`, `240`, `1D` or `D`; read only when `tf` and `timeframe` are absent. An unknown value is a 400.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Same as `interval`; read only when `tf`, `timeframe` and `interval` are absent. An unknown value is a 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max candles to return (1500 = one full day of 1m bars with margin)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO8601 window start, inclusive (defaults to limit×tf back). PRO: floored at now minus 30 days

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO8601 window end, exclusive (defaults to now)

parameters.name: partial
parameters.description: Opt in to partial delivery. When the request's read budget (about 4-7 s of database time) runs out, typically for a dense token over closed months on cold storage: with partial=allow the response is 200 with the newest complete candles, truncated=true and covered_from (continue with to=covered_from); without it the response is 503 with error_kind=read_budget_exhausted, Retry-After and covered_from. Truncation by the per-request call cap (sparse tokens, very wide windows) is always 200 truncated=true, as before.

net_flow_included.description: true on ULTRA — signals whether the net-flow/liquidity fields below are present

quality_checked.description: Added 2026-10-27. true when the per-candle quality list was read; false when that lookup failed, so a null candle quality means not checked rather than no known issue.

truncated.description: true when the read stopped before `limit` candles or `from` were reached: the per-request call cap (always), or the time budget (only with partial=allow; otherwise 503). The returned candles are complete; `covered_from` is the oldest instant searched, so request older candles with `to=covered_from`.

covered_from.description: Oldest instant actually searched; equals `from` when the whole window was scanned

history_floor.description: PRO: now minus 30 days, rounded up to the tf grid (oldest bucket served). null on ULTRA/BUSINESS (no floor)

open_bucket_start.description: Added 2026-11-07. Start of the bucket that contains as_of, on the same UTC grid as the candles (epoch origin). A candle with t at or after it is still OPEN and will change; earlier candles are closed (a closed 1-minute candle can still be revised by a late trade, see the revised events on the live candle channel).

gap_fill.description: Added 2026-11-07. Only stored candles are returned; a bucket with no stored candle is absent and never synthesized (no forward-filled close, no invented zero volume). A stored candle can have trades = 0 and volume_usd = 0 when the price moved without a trade.

history_clamped.description: PRO: part of the requested window was older than history_floor and was cut; `from` echoes the clamped start

history_outside_plan.description: PRO: the whole requested window is older than history_floor, so 200 with zero candles

t.description: Bucket start (ISO timestamp as returned by the OHLC rollup)

quality.description: Known data-quality issue for this candle (added 2026-10-27). null = no known issue (or quality_checked=false). O/H/L/C/volume are never altered; a listed candle is served as stored. On a rolled-up timeframe the WORST status of its 1-minute buckets is shown.

status.description: contaminated_proven: the bucket provably contains a non-trade sample. contaminated_suspected: probable, e.g. the first candle of a token built from a pool-creation sample. unknown: a non-trade sample landed in the bucket but its contribution cannot be separated from real trades.

reason.description: Machine-readable cause, e.g. clmm_v2_create_as_swap (Raydium CLMM pool creations read as swaps until 2026-10-27 08:26 UTC).

flagged_minutes.description: 1-minute buckets inside this candle that are listed (1 on tf=1m).

503.description: error_kind=read_budget_exhausted: the read budget ran out before the window was read and partial=allow was not set. Body carries covered_from and retry_after_seconds; Retry-After header set. Also statement_timeout (error_kind=statement_timeout) when not even one bucket could be read.

post.description:
Same per-mint shape as `GET /tokens/{mint}/buyer-quality`. Shares the LRU cache with the single-mint endpoint — already-warm mints return at ~zero cost. Response includes `cache_hits` counter.

**Coverage** (additive): each item carries `in_scope` (boolean|null) derived from whether that mint had early-buyer rows in our capture — `false` may simply mean 'no early-buyer rows', not proof the token never traded (the batch path does not run the per-mint probe; use the single-mint endpoint for a probed verdict). A top-level `coverage` object carries the shared `history_start` + `scope` markers once.

mints.description: Up to 50 Solana token mints — a comma-separated string or a JSON array

note.description: Present when the mint had no early-buyer rows to score, e.g. "Insufficient buyer data"

in_scope.description: Whether this mint had early-buyer rows in our capture. false may simply mean no early-buyer rows, not proof the token never traded — the batch path skips the per-mint probe GET /tokens/{mint}/buyer-quality runs.

get.description: The token's early buyers with classification (KOL, human, bundle) AND their outcome on this token — `realized_pnl_sol`, `total_sol_bought`/`total_sol_sold`, `first_sell_at`, and `still_holding` — so you can read whether the smart early money profited and has already exited. PRO returns the top 10, ULTRA the full 20 (mv_early_buyer_pnl excludes rank-1, the deployer's own buy). Cohort scope: first 20 buyers (deployer excluded) of launches our deployer pipeline recorded at creation and tracked from that launch; mints admitted later (bags/LaunchLab persist-set, revived curves, restart-loaded history) have no early-buyer cohort, and buyers during an ingest gap are missing.

parameters.name: verify_current_balances
parameters.description: ULTRA+ (2026-10-15): read every scored early buyer's CURRENT balance of this mint (one getTokenAccountsByOwner per wallet: every token account of the owner for the mint, either token program; none = proven zero). All verified or 503 `current_balance_verification_unavailable`, never a partial panel. No RPC call without it.

parameters.name: include_scout_scores
parameters.description: 2026-10-15: add `scout_score` per buyer: a KOL buyer's scout score AS OF its own first buy (no hindsight; the mv_kol_scout_score definition, migration 500 kol_scout_scores_at), null for non-KOLs or when unknown. `scout_scores_status` ok / unavailable / timeout / error.

first_buy_sol.description: SOL paid on the first buy. null = the consideration is unknown (the buy settled in a quote we cannot price, token_early_buyers.first_buy_sol_status unknown_consideration); never reported as 0.

first_buy_sol_status.description: Why first_buy_sol is or is not a number: measured = the SOL paid on the first buy; unknown_consideration = the buy settled in a quote we cannot price, so first_buy_sol is null (never 0).

realized_pnl_sol.description: Realized SOL PnL for this wallet on this token (FIFO cost-basis from confirmed trades).

total_sol_bought.description: SOL this wallet spent on the token. null when first_buy_sol is null (the first buy's cost is unknown, migration 529) or the buyer has no PnL row; never the priced buys alone or 0.

first_sell_at.description: When this early buyer first sold; null if never sold.

still_holding.description: True if the wallet has not sold (first_sell_at is null).

holding_status.description: Only with verify_current_balances=true: the balance, unlike still_holding (swap ledger).

exited_without_sell.description: Only with verify_current_balances=true: zero balance although no sell is on the swap ledger (moved out by transfer or sold off-ledger).

scout_score.description: Only with include_scout_scores=true; KOL buyers only, as of first_buy_at.

historical_win_rate.description: Wallet's all-time win rate (0–1), from mv_alpha_wallets.

buyer_quality_score.description: 0–100 composite quality of the early-buyer cohort.

confidence.description: Confidence in the PREDICTIVE inputs: counts only buyers whose win rate fed the score (≥3 tokens of history, not bot-flagged, not zero-cost-dump dominated). insufficient_data = none did — the score is the neutral-50 default plus penalties. 1 → low, 5+ → medium, 11+ → high.

still_holding.description: Cohort members with no confirmed sell on a tracked venue (swap-ledger scoped — a plain transfer out still reads as holding).

scout_scores_status.description: Only with include_scout_scores=true. unavailable = migration 500 not applied.

onchain_balance_verification.description: Only with verify_current_balances=true, after EVERY scored buyer was read. Reads are not pinned to one slot (slot_min/slot_max).

ranks_completeness.description: Whether early-buyer ranks 1..20 can be trusted for this mint (COV-20). `observed_from_launch` = no firehose gap overlaps launch→last ranked buy; `gap_overlap` = a recorded ingest gap overlaps that window, so a true early buyer may be missing and later ranks shifted; `not_verified` = the check could not run; `no_ranks` = nothing ranked. Ranks are assigned to the first PERSISTED buys at or above the storage floor (`rank_basis`), so they are not necessarily the first on-chain buyers.

gaps_in_open_slots.description: Recorded gaps after the last ranked buy (affect only the open slots)

503.description: current_balance_verification_unavailable: with verify_current_balances=true, at least one balance read failed (retry_after_seconds).

get.description: A live holder census read from the ledger at `confirmed`: every token account of the mint (owner + balance via mint-scoped `getProgramAccounts`), merged per owner. Gives an EXACT `holder_count` (distinct non-zero owners minus excluded pools/curves/burns), `token_accounts_nonzero`, ranks 1–100 retained, and `top1/top10/top20/top50/top100_share` over the circulating denominator. Each disclosed owner is labelled from MadeOnSol wallet intelligence (deployer / kol / early_buyer / bundle / bot / dump_cluster). Program-derived owners (liquidity pools, bonding curves, vaults) and burn addresses are EXCLUDED from the denominator and listed in `excluded[]` — the #1 raw account of a fresh memecoin is its own bonding curve. Disclosure: PRO ranks 1–10, ULTRA 1–50, BUSINESS 1–100; the maths is tier-independent. Measured latency: fresh pump.fun mints <1 s, $0.1–2M memecoins ~0.1–1.2 s, 200k–550k-account tokens 6–11 s (503 `holder_scan_in_progress` then cached). Mega-caps the provider refuses (TRUMP/JUP/BONK class) fall back to the top-20 `getTokenLargestAccounts` view with `holder_count: null` and `source.census_fallback_reason` set — never a trade-derived estimate. The same fallback applies when the census times out, and (since 2026-10-02) when a census's balances add up to more than the mint's supply: such a read is not one consistent ledger snapshot, so it is refused rather than served (`census_fallback_reason: census_inconsistent_sum_exceeds_supply`). Since 2026-11-09 the route waits up to 12 s for a fresh scan, and for wSOL, whose census repeatedly times out upstream, the census is paused for at most 6 h after 2 consecutive header timeouts and a fresh top-20 is served instead (`census_fallback_reason: census_skipped_repeated_timeouts`). Distinct from `/cap-table` (who bought first) — this is who holds NOW.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Not available yet (served only once the Solana holder index is activated; until then the parameter is ignored and the answer is the census path below). `index` asks the MadeOnSol Solana holder index first: a live index snapshot answers with the index top 100 (cut to the tier depth), `concentration.holder_count` from the index and an `index` object (`status: live`, `epoch`, `seq`, `finalized_slot`, `changed_slot`), no census. While the index is restarting or repairing (no store commit for 120 s) the same answer carries the LAST VERIFIED list with `index.status: stale` and `index.reason: store_stale`; `slot`, `as_of` and `age_seconds` show how old it is, and it is never labelled live. Any other index outcome answers the census path and says why in `index.status`: `not_covered` (mint not in the admitted set), `resync_required` (+ `reason`, e.g. `mint_stale`), `unavailable` (+ `reason`: relay timeout / unreachable / invalid payload) or `excluded` (KIN, USDC, USDT; `reason: excluded_mint`). `census` = the default path. Other values are a 400 (`invalid_source`); `source=index` with `include_wallet_flags=true` is a 400 (`incompatible_parameters`).

parameters.name: include_wallet_flags
parameters.description: Opt in (TR-07) to per-holder `wallet_flags` + top-level `wallet_flags_meta`. Solana: PRO+ (route tier), tier-disclosed rows only. Flags come from MadeOnSol's indexed wallet populations: a `false`/`null` with `label_coverage.evaluated=false` means insufficient evidence, NOT a verified negative. Any value other than true/false is a 400 (`invalid_include_wallet_flags`).

slot.description: Ledger slot the holder set was read at.

age_seconds.description: Added 2026-11-07. Seconds since as_of (the measurement). Answers are cached 60 s to 10 min per mint.

amount_raw.description: Raw u64 balance as a string — never a float.

labels.description: Empty = unknown to us, not verified clean. sniper / bundler_wallet / dumper / alpha_tracked appear only with include_wallet_flags=true.

wallet_flags.description: Only with include_wallet_flags=true; null when the flag sources were unavailable.

label_coverage.description: Per label: evaluated=false means no sufficient evidence (not a verified negative).

disclosed.description: Rank cap by tier: 10 PRO, 50 ULTRA, 100 BUSINESS.

reason.description: pool = vault authority of a known pool (dex + pool_address set); bonding_curve = pump.fun / LaunchLab curve; burn = incinerator / system program; program_account = off-curve owner we could not attribute to a known pool (vault, escrow, staking, unknown pool).

dex.description: pumpfun | pumpswap | raydium | launchlab | meteora | orca | jupiter — when named.

holder_count.description: Exact distinct non-zero owners minus excluded pools/curves/burns, at slot (census). null only when the census was not served (provider refusal, timeout or an inconsistent census; see source.census_fallback_reason) — never estimated from trades.

holder_count_status.description: Added 2026-11-07. measured = exact census at slot; not_measured = the top-20 view (holder_count null).

holder_count_reason.description: Added 2026-11-07. Why not measured: the census fallback code (census_exceeds_provider_limit, census_timed_out, census_inconsistent_sum_exceeds_supply, census_failed, …) or top20_view. Never provider error text.

supply_raw.description: Percentage denominator. Normally the on-chain mint supply read in this request; null when no supply consistent with the disclosed balances is available (every percentage is then null, never above 100).

supply_source.description: index_mint_account (source=index only, once activated): the on-chain mint supply the holder index read at the same finalized slot as the balances (index.supply_as_of_slot).

supply_consistent.description: false = the only available supply was below what the disclosed owners hold, so percentages are withheld.

pool_and_program_pct.description: Share of TOTAL supply sitting in pools/curves/vaults/burns among the excluded owners (= pool_pct + burned_pct + program_pct).

pool_pct.description: Share of total supply in NAMED pools + bonding curves (excluded[].reason pool | bonding_curve).

burned_pct.description: Share of total supply at burn addresses.

program_pct.description: Share of total supply held by off-curve owners we could not attribute (excluded[].reason program_account).

ranked_owners_available.description: How many ranked owners the scan retained (≤100 census, ≤20 fallback).

index.description: Only with source=index (once the Solana holder index is activated). Balances on the index path are ABSOLUTE wallet aggregates in base units, verified through finalized_slot; seq rises with every change of the published holder count or top 100 inside one epoch (a different epoch = rebuilt index, seq restarted).

reason.description: null when live; not_covered; the relay's resync reason (mint_stale, epoch_changed, seq_regressed, slow_consumer, not_covered); relay_timeout / relay_unreachable / relay_not_configured / relay_http_<status> / invalid_payload_<check>; excluded_mint.

seq.description: Publication sequence for this mint inside epoch (live only).

finalized_slot.description: Slot the index is verified through (live only).

changed_slot.description: Finalized slot of the last change of this mint's publication (live only).

head_slot.description: The index follower's observed finalized chain tip (same commitment as finalized_slot), never below finalized_slot. null when unknown (follower status missing or older than 30 s). Live/stale index answers only.

lag_slots.description: head_slot - finalized_slot: how many finalized slots the verified list trails the chain. A list can be commit-fresh and still far behind (e.g. after a follower restart); judge liveness by this, not by age_seconds. null when head_slot is unknown.

supply_status.description: Whether the index proved the ON-CHAIN MINT SUPPLY at finalized_slot. known: holders[].pct_of_supply = balance / concentration.supply_raw (supply_source index_mint_account), both at the same finalized slot. unknown: every pct_of_supply is null (never 0, never from cached prices). Live/stale index answers only.

supply_slot.description: Slot of the last observed write to the mint account (mint, burn, authority change) or of the seed read; at most finalized_slot. null when unknown.

supply_as_of_slot.description: Slot the supply is stated at; equals finalized_slot when known (same finalized state as the balances), null when unknown.

census_fallback_reason.description: Why the full census was not served (null on a census). `census_exceeds_provider_limit` = the provider refused it (mega-caps); `census_exceeds_local_limit` = the provider's answer was larger than our census size limit (768 MiB, more than twice the largest census we serve, 2026-10-24); `census_timed_out`; `census_inconsistent_sum_exceeds_supply` = the census balances summed past the mint supply (or the supply could not be read), so it was refused (2026-10-02); `census_failed: <detail>` otherwise. `note` explains it in prose.

503.description: `error_kind: holder_scan_in_progress` (Retry-After 20) — large established tokens take 5–30 s to enumerate upstream; the scan continues and is cached, so the retry is instant. Or `holder_rpc_unavailable` (Retry-After 15). Either way we fail closed rather than serve a trade-derived guess.

get.summary: Top traders on a token (by realized PnL)
get.description: Every wallet that traded this mint, ranked by realized SOL PnL (or ROI), using the SAME FIFO cost basis as `/wallet/{address}/pnl` (TR-16, 2026-10-14) — so a wallet's `realized_pnl_sol` here equals its per-token value there for the same window. Sells are matched only against earlier observed buys; tokens sold without an observed buy (transfers in, buys under the persistence floor, buys before the window) are reported as `unmatched_sell_tokens` and their proceeds are NOT counted as profit (`cost_basis_complete: false`). `cost_method` says which method answered: `fifo`, or `average_cost` (legacy, overstates profit on unmatched sells) while the FIFO function is not yet available. `unrealized_pnl_sol` / `held_value_sol` / `total_pnl_sol` are null when a wallet still holds a token we cannot price (never valued at 0). Each trader is enriched with our reputation data (is_kol, is_alpha_tracked + bot_confidence + historical win rate) so you can separate smart money from a bot round-trip. Distinct from `/cap-table` (first ~20 EARLY buyers by entry order): this ranks ALL traders by profit. PRO returns top 25, ULTRA top 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Page start within the ranking. `rank` continues across pages; the visible window stays capped at the tier's row ceiling (offset+limit ≤ 25 PRO / 100 ULTRA — paging past it returns an empty page).

schema.description: Drop dust wallets that bought less than this.

cost_method.description: fifo = same cost basis as /wallet/{address}/pnl. average_cost = legacy fallback (unmatched sells counted at zero cost).

snapshot.description: Present only when the ranking is served from a shared precomputed snapshot (migration 549, when enabled): always for window_days 7, 14, 30 and 90; for any other window only after its live ranking exceeded the time budget once (window_days is never rounded). The ranking is exact as of `as_of`: the window is (`window_start`, `as_of`]. Absent on the live path.

status.description: fresh = at most 15 minutes old; stale = older but at most 2 hours (served, labelled). Older snapshots are never served: the request answers 503 with snapshot_status.

wallets_ranked.description: Wallets in the snapshot before min_bought_sol / limit.

completeness.description: Realized-PnL completeness. incomplete when at least one sell in the response has proceeds that went to another wallet (price_status proceeds_unattributed, migration 508): realized PnL and ROI then cover the known basis only, and the basis those sells consumed is reported as unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol, never as 0 proceeds or a loss. This is realized-PnL completeness. It is NOT `coverage.completeness` (source-coverage verification: verified / not_verified / ...), which says whether the trade capture for this subject is proven complete.

incomplete_reasons.description: Empty when complete. /wallet/{address} emits only proceeds_unattributed; /tokens/{mint}/top-traders emits proceeds_unattributed and, since migration 548 (2026-11-11), unknown_consideration; unknown_consideration and missing_cost_basis (sales without an observed purchase) are shared with the FIFO routes (/pnl, /positions).

realized_pnl_sol.description: Realized SOL PnL on the matched portion (cost basis per cost_method), known basis only: sells whose proceeds went to another wallet are excluded (migration 508). Negative for losers; a row with realized_status unknown is not a loser.

unrealized_pnl_sol.description: null when still holding and the token has no price.

roi.description: Realized ROI as a fraction of the cost basis of the matched (sold) portion. null if nothing matched.

unmatched_sell_tokens.description: FIFO only: tokens sold without an observed earlier buy; their proceeds are excluded from realized PnL. null under average_cost.

cost_basis_complete.description: FIFO only: true when every sold token matched an observed buy and no sold or open token has an unknown cost (migration 548). null under average_cost.

unknown_consideration_trades.description: Migration 548 (2026-11-11), FIFO only: trades whose SOL consideration is unknown, counted per event like trades. The wallet settled them in another token (for example USDC, or a token-to-token swap routed through SOL) or they are unpriced: SOL comes only from the wallet's own SOL settlement, exactly like /wallet/{address}/pnl. Their tokens move the position; they add no cost or proceeds (never 0). null under average_cost.

unknown_cost_tokens_sold.description: Migration 548, FIFO only: tokens sold out of lots bought with unknown consideration. That part of the sale realizes nothing (no gain, no loss). null under average_cost.

open_unknown_cost_tokens.description: Migration 548, FIFO only: open tokens bought with unknown consideration. While > 0, unrealized_pnl_sol and total_pnl_sol are null (cost basis unknown). null under average_cost.

unknown_realized_cost_basis_sol.description: Migration 508: cost basis consumed by sells whose proceeds went to another wallet. NOT in realized_pnl_sol or ROI (neither a loss nor a gain). 0 when complete.

unattributed_sells.description: Migration 508: sells with price_status proceeds_unattributed. 0 when complete.

realized_status.description: known = no unattributed sell; partial = some sells unattributed (realized on the known basis); unknown = every sell unattributed: the outcome is unknown, not a loss (same vocabulary as /pnl closed_positions).

historical_win_rate.description: Wallet's all-time win rate (0–1), from mv_alpha_wallets.

503.description: Retry later (Retry-After header). Either the token has too much trade history to rank live right now, or (snapshot-served windows) its shared snapshot is still being built or too old to serve: `snapshot_status` building | expired. Never an empty ranking in place of data.

get.description:
Transparent 0–100 rug-risk score (higher = riskier) with a per-factor breakdown — mint/freeze authority, liquidity depth & thinness, Token-2022 transfer fee, LP burn, bundled/sniped open, deployer track record, KOL distribution, supply inflation (on-chain supply grown above expected = stealth-mint/dilution), and blacklist. Composed from the same data layer as `GET /token/{mint}` (no extra latency). Returns `band` (safe/caution/danger), `factors[]` (each with `status` + `points` + `detail`), and the raw `inputs` (including `supply_inflation_pct` and `sniper_footprint`). The top-level `dev` block (nullable) is the deployer self-activity read: create-tx self-buy (`buy_sol`/`buy_tokens`/`buy_supply_pct`), post-create own-mint trading (`bought_tokens_after`, `sold_tokens`, `sold_sol`, `first_sell_at`/`last_sell_at`), and live on-chain holdings (`holdings_tokens`, `holdings_supply_pct`, `wallet_empty`), each with its own observation time (`holdings_observed_at`, `activity_rollup_through`), plus `transfer_status` (`none_detected` | `suspected` | `unknown`): a balance below what the dev's own recorded trades explain is only ever SUSPECTED (a sell on an uncaptured venue looks identical), and misaligned or missing observations are `unknown`; `transferred_out` is its deprecated boolean view. Carries `score_version` (now `v2`) and `as_of` (response time — not an observation time).

**Score v2 (2026-09-21):** the LP factor no longer credits a token-SUPPLY burn (mc-tracker's burn flag) — LP custody is not observed for Solana pools, so `lp_burn` is warn/8 with `inputs.lp_burn_status: unknown` unless verified LP evidence exists; an unknown transfer fee is warn/4, not "No transfer fee"; deployer reputation scores only an established history. `assessment` says whether every input was observed: `incomplete` lists `unknown_inputs` and the band is never `safe`; a failed lookup of a score-critical input is a retryable 503 (`code: risk_inputs_unavailable`), never a score computed without it. **Same loader on every transport:** `POST /tokens/batch/risk` and x402 return identical scores for identical evidence; batch skips only the live dev-holdings RPC (`dev.holdings_*` null, `transfer_status: unknown`). The `coverage` object (shared TradeCoverage shape) discloses whether the mint sits inside the launchpad trade capture, with a note naming which sub-fields are trade-derived (cohort/sniper/bundle factors, dev sell rollup) vs pure on-chain reads (authorities, liquidity, live holdings) that are unaffected. PRO+.

resolved_from.description: Present only when the path address was a liquidity pool that we resolved to its token mint (2026-09-05). Absent otherwise.

source.description: How the pool was resolved: from our pool index, or decoded live on-chain (PumpSwap).

mint.description: The mint scored. Equals the path value unless the path was a PumpSwap pool address, in which case this is the pool's resolved mint and `resolved_from` is set.

band.description: Never `safe` while assessment.status is `incomplete`, or with an un-revoked mint/freeze authority

score_version.description: v2.1 scores measured primary-pool LP shares. v2 uses the legacy LP status when no eligible measurement is available.

status.description: ok/warn/danger = evidence read and scored. unknown = the input should exist but could not be read or is insufficient (0 points; listed in assessment.unknown_inputs; band never safe). not_assessed = no evidence source applies to this token (0 points; listed in assessment.not_assessed). Neither is ever positive evidence.

inputs.description: Every scorer input. Enrichment fields are null when unobserved — unknown, not false/0.

token_supply_burn_detected.description: The mint's supply decreased (token burn). Not LP evidence.

lp_burn_status.description: LP burn/lock evidence: `verified` only with measured LP-token custody (lp_burnt_pct ≥ 99). No Solana writer populates LP custody yet, so today every token is `unknown`. A token-supply burn is never promoted to an LP claim.

lp_shares.description: Measured shares of the primary pool LP ledger at observed_at, truncated to four decimal places.

deployer_history_status.description: null when there is no deployer

deployer_reputation_scored.description: Whether the bonding rate moved the score (established history only)

liquidity_observed_at.description: When the liquidity figure was last observed (mc-tracker last trade). With the creator not assessed, band safe requires this within the last 6 h (null or more than 5 min in the future = not fresh). 6 h is a policy threshold, not proof that the liquidity is still there.

status.description: incomplete = at least one score input is unknown; the score is a lower bound

unknown_inputs.description: Inputs not observed for this token (e.g. transfer_fee, mint_authority, liquidity, kol_activity, deployer_reputation, blacklist, supply_inflation, launch_cohort). deployer_reputation is unknown when a creator lookup failed, when a LAUNCHPAD mint's creator was not recorded (a coverage gap), or when a known creator has no established history.

explanations.description: Why each unknown / not-assessed input is listed, keyed by input name, plus band_cap when the band was capped (creator not assessed and liquidity / liquidity-to-MC not both ok, or the liquidity figure older than 6 h — a policy threshold, not proof of safety). Missing required creator information never yields band safe, for any token.

not_assessed.description: Dimensions not measured for this token that are NOT a failed lookup: lp_custody (never observed for Solana pools) and deployer_reputation only when the token has no launchpad origin in our capture (no deploy row, no bonding-curve pool, not PumpSwap-primary, no pump/bonk/BAGS vanity suffix). A launchpad mint with an unrecorded creator, or a failed origin lookup, is an unknown input instead.

dev_status.description: ok = dev block present · not_found = no pending_deploys row (not a launchpad deploy we saw) · unavailable = the lookup failed

dev.description: Dev-wallet activity (migration 225). Trade-derived fields are accurate THROUGH activity_rollup_through; holdings are observed at holdings_observed_at — never at as_of.

holdings_tokens.description: Live on-chain balance (60 s cache); null = RPC unavailable or not checked (batch)

holdings_observed_at.description: When the RPC balance was observed (cache fetch time)

activity_rollup_through.description: Dev trades are rolled up through this time (dev_activity cursor)

expected_tokens_from_trades.description: Balance the dev's own recorded trades explain, aligned to holdings_observed_at

transfer_status.description: suspected = balance below what recorded trades explain (a sell on an uncaptured venue looks identical) — never a verified transfer; unknown = observations misaligned, rollup stale, no coverage, or holdings not checked

transferred_out.description: DEPRECATED boolean view of transfer_status: true = suspected, false = none_detected, null = unknown

as_of.description: Response time — not the observation time of any input

400.description: The address is valid base58 but is not a token mint. `code` says what it is: `wallet_not_mint` (a system-owned account — wallet intel lives at /wallet/{address}, KOL routes at /kol/{wallet}; `hint` carries both), `token_account_not_mint` (a holder's token account; `mint` + `risk_url` point at the right mint when it can be read), `pool_not_mint` (a Raydium / Meteora / Orca pool we could not resolve; `dex` names it — pass the pool's base mint). Also `evm_address_on_solana_route` for a 0x address (`rhc_endpoint` names the Robinhood Chain twin) and `mint_lowercased` for a mint that lost its case.

404.description: `code: not_tracked` — a real mint that has never traded in our capture (carries `resolved_from` + `mint` when the path was a pool we resolved), or `code: not_on_chain` — no account with this address exists on Solana mainnet (checked live), i.e. not a coverage gap on our side.

503.description: A score-critical input (token_prices, blacklist, supply drift, snapshot) could not be read. Retry after `Retry-After`; no score is returned rather than one computed without it. Body: `{ error, code: "risk_inputs_unavailable", unavailable_inputs: string[], retryable: true, retry_after_seconds }`. Distinct from a missing row, which is scored as an unknown input.

get.summary: Share of supply held now by all bundle wallets (PRO+)
get.description: ONE figure for a terminal (2026-10-15): `bundled_pct_of_supply_now`, the share of circulating supply held RIGHT NOW by every bundle wallet: the launch bundle (first-20 early buyers flagged as bundle) plus every wallet of a coordinated buy cluster in the window (`/tokens/{mint}/bundles`), each wallet counted once, read from chain balances: up to 60 wallets one getTokenAccountsByOwner each (cached 30 seconds); a larger set (busy tokens, since 2026-11-10) is summed from ONE holders census of the mint at a single slot (`balance_method: census`, `held_now.slot_min`, denominator = the mint supply read in that census, cached 5 minutes and shared with `/tokens/{mint}/holders`). The wallet set comes from every cluster wallet in the window (`wallet_set`, cap 20,000; `wallet_set.incomplete_reason: wallet_set_truncated` above it). Null when the wallet set is incomplete, the census was refused, timed out, still running (`census_in_progress`, retry shortly) or over its budget (`census_budget_exhausted` + `retry_after_seconds`), never a partial sum or an estimated zero. Shared by every caller (`as_of`). Before migration 501 is applied it counts the launch bundle only and says so (`scope: launch_cohort_only`).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Which later clusters to include (the launch bundle is always included).

bundled_pct_of_supply_now.description: RATIO in [0, 1]: the BROAD same-slot (Solana) / same-block (Robinhood Chain) HEURISTIC: share of supply held now by the launch bundle plus EVERY buyer in a slot/block with min_wallets+ distinct buyers in the window. On busy tokens many of those buyers share a slot by chance, so this is an upper-bound style heuristic, NOT a count of proven bundles and not comparable to third-party 'bundler' figures. Prefer strict_bundle_pct_of_supply_now for the proven measure. Null unless the wallet set is known complete (clusters_complete true) AND every wallet was read (see held_now.incomplete_reason). Value semantics unchanged since 2026-10-15.

bundled_pct_basis.description: Names what bundled_pct_of_supply_now measures (2026-11-11): the broad same-slot / same-block heuristic.

strict_bundle_pct_of_supply_now.description: RATIO in [0, 1] (2026-11-11): the STRICT measure, a PROVEN LOWER BOUND: share of supply held now by the launch bundle plus the same-slot buyers that share ONE transaction with another buyer. Nothing else admits a wallet (an identical buy amount is not evidence; a funding link only counts between two wallets already in the set, so it never adds one). Bundles that used separate transactions are not counted. Same balance read and supply as bundled_pct_of_supply_now. Null with strict_bundle.incomplete_reason when not known (never 0 for unknown). Always null on Robinhood Chain (not_supported_on_chain).

strict_bundle.description: How the strict measure was computed (2026-11-11; admission tightened the same day to launch bundle + same transaction).

definition.description: Was launch_bundle_plus_linked_same_slot_buyers (identical amount and funding admitted wallets) until the 2026-11-11 tightening.

basis.description: The strict figure is a lower bound: every wallet in it is proven, but not every bundle wallet is proven.

funding_evidence_since.description: Funding data (wallet_funding_links, funding_context) only exists since this date.

status.description: unavailable = the strict wallet-set function is not deployed (latched 5 minutes); not_supported = no strict evidence on this chain.

incomplete_reason.description: Why there is no strict figure: strict_function_unavailable, strict_wallet_set_timeout, strict_wallet_set_error, strict_rule_outdated (the server still runs the looser pre-tightening rule), strict_wallet_set_truncated, wallet_set_unavailable, not_supported_on_chain, not_every_wallet_read, supply_unknown, census_subset_unavailable, or the held_now.incomplete_reason of the shared balance read.

linked_cluster_wallets.description: Same-transaction same-slot wallets not already in the launch cohort.

evidence.description: Admission evidence per type. Since the 2026-11-11 tightening only same_transaction_wallets admits wallets; identical_amount_wallets and funding_link_wallets are kept for compatibility and are always null.

funding_context.description: Context only, admits nothing: strict wallets with a wallet_funding_links edge to another strict wallet. Funding data only exists since funding_evidence_since, so 0 for an older launch means no data, not no link.

scope.description: launch_cohort_only = the cluster function was not available; only the launch bundle is counted.

clusters_complete.description: True only when every coordinated buy cluster in the window was read: clusters_status ok AND fewer than clusters_limit clusters came back. False when the cluster list hit clusters_limit (older clusters in the window may be missing; held_now.incomplete_reason clusters_truncated) or the cluster function was not available (scope launch_cohort_only). bundled_pct_of_supply_now is null whenever this is false (2026-10-15).

clusters_limit.description: Most clusters read per request (200) on the older cluster read; null when the wallet set comes from every cluster wallet (wallet_set.source token_bundle_wallet_set).

wallet_set.description: Where the bundle wallet set came from (2026-11-10). token_bundle_wallet_set = every cluster wallet in the window, at most wallet_cap; token_bundle_clusters = the older read (200 clusters x 50 wallets).

balance_method.description: per_wallet = one getTokenAccountsByOwner per wallet (up to 60); census = one holders census of the mint at one slot; none = the wallet set was incomplete, nothing was read.

held_now.description: Same shape as the bundle held_now of this chain. incomplete_reason adds clusters_truncated (the cluster list hit clusters_limit; balances are not read) next to cluster_wallets_truncated (a cluster has more wallets than the 50 listed).

get.summary: Insider sell pressure: net selling by creator, early buyers, bundlers and KOLs over 5 and 15 minutes (PRO+)
get.description: Net SOL selling by the wallets closest to a token over the last 5 and 15 minutes (windows end at `as_of`, measured on our ingest clock, `time_basis: ingest_clock`), set against the window's buy volume and the token's liquidity. Cohorts: `creator` (protocol creator from the launch record; a proven platform signer is reported as such and not counted), `early_buyers` (first persisted buyers, up to 20), `bundlers` (wallets of coordinated buy clusters, see /tokens/{mint}/bundles) and `kols` (active KOL roster wallets that traded the token in the window). `insiders` counts each wallet ONCE even when it sits in several cohorts; `by_cohort` repeats it per cohort, so the cohort figures can add up to more than `insiders`. Positive `net_sell_*` = the cohort sold more SOL than it bought. Amounts are the SOL exchanged in stored trades. A trade whose SOL value is not proven (a non-SOL quote we could not price) is counted in `unpriced_trades`, `amounts` becomes `partial` and every net and ratio that depends on it is null with `null_reasons` `unpriced_trades`, never 0. A window that overlaps a recorded capture gap is `gap_overlap` with null nets (`firehose_gap`); when a recorded gap has no usable time bound the window is `gap_unverified` with null nets (`gap_state_unverified`), never `ok`; a token our trade capture does not admit is `not_captured` with null amounts. Ratio nulls: `no_buy_volume`, `buy_volume_incomplete`, `liquidity_unknown` (also when the token has no elected primary pool, `liquidity.status` no_primary_pool), `liquidity_stale` (price row older than 15 minutes), `sol_price_unavailable`. Cached 15 s per token.

bundlers.description: not_measured = the token launched before bundle detection started (2026-10-15 14:46 UTC) and has no cluster on record.

completeness.description: Per window `{status: no_known_gap | gap_overlap | not_verified, overlapping}` plus `capture`: captured | capture_unverified | not_captured.

status.description: no_primary_pool = the token has no elected primary pool: the stored figure is a residual, so liquidity_usd is null and the liquidity ratio is withheld (liquidity_unknown).

503.description: The token traded too heavily to aggregate right now; retry after retry_after_seconds.

get.summary: Every coordinated buy cluster on a token, launch and later (PRO+)
get.description: Every slot in the window where at least `min_wallets` distinct wallets bought the token, the launch bundle AND clusters that enter later (2026-10-15). `/tokens/{mint}/bundle` remains the launch-cohort view (first 20 early buyers). Per cluster: slot, time, `minutes_after_launch` + `phase`, `wallet_count`, `new_wallets` (no earlier buy of the token), `atomic_txs` (transactions carrying 3+ of them = definitively coordinated), SOL and token volume, wallets. `summary.baseline` gives the window's buys per active slot, because on very busy tokens unrelated buyers share slots: a cluster is evidence, not a verdict. Only STORED buys count (no size floor from 2026-10-22T19:53:00.000Z; rows stored before it keep the legacy 0.05 SOL / $3.50 buy floor; rows before 2026-06-17 have no slot). `include_balances=true` adds `held_now` (current balances from the chain) to the 3 most recent clusters.

parameters.name: min_wallets
parameters.description: Minimum distinct buyers in one slot/block to count as a cluster.

parameters.name: include_balances
parameters.description: Add `held_now` (current balances from the chain) to the 3 most recent clusters.

200.description: OK. An empty clusters array means no slot/block in the window had min_wallets distinct buyers.

baseline.description: Window baseline (null when no cluster was found): active units, buys in window, buys per active unit. On busy tokens unrelated buyers share slots.

new_wallets.description: Buyers with no earlier buy of this token.

held_now.description: Only with include_balances=true, on the 3 most recent clusters: same shape as the bundle held_now of this chain; totals only when every wallet was read.

exit.description: What this cluster's wallets have SOLD of the token since the cluster (bundle-watch sell ledger, migration 503). null = not followed (only clusters bundle-watch announced: >= 3 wallets new to the token; followed 7 days after detection; first 50 wallets).

sold_pct.description: Sum over wallets of min(sold, bought in the cluster) / bought in the cluster, 0..1.

realized_status.description: Migration 511: incomplete when at least one recorded sell has unknown proceeds (Solana price_status proceeds_unattributed, or no quote amount); its tokens count in sold_pct, its proceeds are NOT in realized_sol (never booked as 0). null = not measured (ledger before migration 511).

unknown_proceeds_sells.description: Recorded sells with unknown proceeds (see realized_status).

exit_tracking.description: Whether the exit ledger could be read; the clusters are served either way (exit null when not ok).

503.description: bundle_clusters_unavailable (SQL function not applied) or bundle_clusters_temporarily_unavailable (timeout).

get.description: The token's **bundle cohort** — the same-slot wallets (≥3 buying in one slot, `is_bundle`) — and how much of supply they STILL hold, computed from confirmed on-chain trades (not a pre-execution shred feed). `held_pct_of_supply` (net held ÷ circulating supply) is the headline rug/insider signal; `bundle_kind` distinguishes a definitively-atomic single-tx bundle (`atomic_tx`) from a possibly-coincidental `same_slot` cohort. Field-gated on ALL tiers: BASIC gets the scalar `bundle` block; PRO adds the top-10 wallets (flags only); ULTRA adds the full cohort enriched with KOL/alpha identity. Caveats: `buy_volume` is cumulative buy volume (can exceed supply); `tokens_held` is a swap-derived net position, not a holder census. The `coverage` object (additive) separates 'no bundle cohort' from 'mint outside our launchpad trade capture'.

parameters.name: include_balances
parameters.description: PRO+ (2026-10-15): add `held_now`, the bundle cohort's CURRENT balances (one getTokenAccountsByOwner per wallet, at most 20), next to the swap-derived `bundle.*`. Totals only for a complete read.

404.description: Token not found or not tracked

get.description: Per-venue **liquidity map** — every DEX pool the token trades in (pump.fun / PumpSwap / Raydium / Meteora / Orca), which pools are live vs parked, and how fragmented its liquidity is across venues. Each pool carries its `dex`, `quote_mint`, `liquidity_usd`, `last_price_sol`, `last_swap_at`, `amm_id`, and an `is_active` flag; the `summary` rolls up `pool_count` / `active_pool_count` / `dex_count`, the `primary_pool` + `primary_dex`, and `top_pool_share_pct` (how concentrated liquidity is in the single deepest pool). Complements `GET /token/{mint}`, which returns only a single aggregate liquidity number. PRO+.

dex.description: Venue (e.g. pumpfun, pumpswap, raydium, meteora, orca)

amm_id.description: Raydium pool-state id; null on other venues.

top_pool_share_pct.description: Share of total liquidity held by the single deepest pool (0–100)

universe.description: The inventory is the deepest max_pools pools by liquidity (audit F19); summary totals cover the returned pools. truncated=true = more pools exist past the cut.

404.description: Token not found or not tracked

get.summary: Token locks & vesting on a mint (Streamflow, Jupiter Lock, Bonfida, Smithii, Sablier)
get.description: Every **on-chain token lock / vesting contract** on a mint — Streamflow streams, Jupiter Lock vesting escrows and Bonfida token-vesting accounts, plus Smithii vesting and Sablier Lockup streams while they are listed in 'meta.programs' (rows are admitted only after per-account verification; Sablier's 'recipient' is the current proven stream-NFT holder or null, see 'holder_status') — decoded from the locker programs' account state (Yellowstone account subscription + daily getProgramAccounts reconciliation, mig 326). Each contract carries the schedule (start / cliff / period / end, cliff and per-period amounts), the terms (cancelable by sender/recipient, transferable, top-up) and a **live-derived** view computed at request time: what is still locked right now, what has unlocked, what is claimable, and the 'next_unlock' event. The 'summary' rolls up locked / deposited totals (raw, ui, usd, % of supply), the **7d / 30d forward unlock schedule**, the nearest next unlock across all contracts, distinct lockers and how many active contracts the sender can still cancel. Answers *did the team lock, how much, until when, and can they pull it*. **LP locks are not included** (this is token/vesting locks). Amounts are base-unit strings; ui/usd/pct are null when decimals/price are unknown ('token.facts_resolved'). PRO+.

parameters.description: Filter the list (summary always covers all rows)

price_usd.description: Token price used for the *_usd fields (null when unknown or guarded as phantom).

seconds_until_end.description: Seconds until fully unlocked (>= 0). 0 once completed; null when there is no end date (perpetual) or the lock was cancelled/closed.

seconds_until_next_unlock.description: Seconds until next_unlock.at (>= 0); null when there is no next unlock.

kind.description: lock = whole amount at one date; vesting = cliff and/or periodic release

status.description: Derived at request time

recipient.description: Beneficiary. sablier_lockup: the CURRENT proven holder of the stream NFT only; null when the holder is not currently proven (see holder_status), never the last proven holder. smithii_vesting: the authority for single-receiver locks, null for merkle receivers (off-chain).

holder_proven_at_slot.description: sablier_lockup only: slot of the read that last proved last_proven_holder.

withdrawn_raw.description: Claimed so far; null when the program does not expose it (withdrawn_tracked false: smithii_vesting)

claimable_raw.description: Unlocked but not yet withdrawn; null when withdrawn is not tracked

get.summary: Token momentum fires — new-token surges + dormant-token revivals
get.description: Newest **momentum fires**, newest first. Two kinds: **surge** — a token < 30 min old whose market cap runs hard vs its launch MC (tier 'early' ≤10 min / ≥$12k / ≥3× launch MC; 'strong' ≤30 min / ≥$30k / ≥6× and ≥2× the lowest sample of the last 3 min; 'breakout' ≤2 min / ≥$45k / ≥8×; each tier fires once per mint, and only when SUSTAINED — the level must hold on the current tick and on a sample ≥10 s older, nothing before 20 s of age, so a one-tick same-slot bundle mark is not a surge) — and **revival** — a token with no 1-minute trade candle for ≥24 h that started trading again, CONFIRMED by real buys + buy volume from the tape (≥5 buys, ≥$500 buy volume, ≥1.5× the pre-dormancy MC), never by the price mark alone. Hard gates on both kinds: liquidity ≥ $1.5k and ≥ 2% of MC when known (a thin-pool 'MC' is an artefact), MC ≤ $100B, and the MC gained must be PAID FOR — buy volume on the tape ≥ 3% × (MC − launch / pre-dormancy MC); a price mark moves MC on ~$0 of volume. Every fire carries the burst tape (buys/sells/volume with 'tape.source' = candles | wallet_trades | null — the open minute candle lands only at rollover, so a < 90 s-old surge is measured on the live wallet tape where covered; unique buyers where the mint is in token_trades coverage), tracked-KOL involvement, the first-20 early-buyer cohort (bundled / sold / sniper wallets), deployer reputation and 'risk_flags[]' (bundled_launch, few_buyers, wash_pattern, thin_liquidity, cold_deployer, sniper_heavy, early_buyers_exiting, sell_pressure, no_tape_trades, no_prior_price, mint_authority_active, transfer_fee). Fires ≥65 min old carry 'outcome' (+1 h MC / peak / low) and '?stats=1' prints per-tier hit-rates — out-of-sample by construction. Filters are DB-native: 'kind', 'tier', 'mint', 'launchpad', 'deployer_tier', 'min_mc_usd'/'max_mc_usd', 'min_buys', 'exclude_flags' (comma list), 'only_clean=1'. Cursors 'since'/'before' on fired_at. Pushed live on the **'token:surges'** WebSocket channel and the webhook registry as 'token:surge' / 'token:revival'. The thresholds are echoed in 'definitions' so the docs can never drift from what fires. PRO+.
